`examples/cities-skylines-city-dashboard/tools/mock_game.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Serve the dashboard page with a synthetic city, so it can be opened and tested without the game.

    python3 tools/mock_game.py                 # http://127.0.0.1:19681, page assembled from web/src
    python3 tools/mock_game.py --port 8000 --web path/to/web

It answers the same routes as the mod (/, /api/cidade, /api/mapa, /api/servicos, /api/historico, /api/dianoite)
in the same wire format. Every number here is made up by this script: no game data is involved. The city is
deterministic (fixed seed) and the clock, traffic and day/night samples move a little on every request, so the
page's live refresh has something to show.
"""
import argparse, base64, glob, json, math, os, random, time
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer

FIELDS = ["x", "z", "ang", "larg", "comp", "classe", "nivel", "problema", "nome", "poluicao", "felicidade", "saude", "moradores",
          "valorTerreno", "ruido", "bombeiros", "policia", "saudeCob", "funeraria", "fundamental", "medio", "superior",
          "transporte", "lazer", "crime", "lixo", "distrito", "id"]
CLASSES = ["Residential/ResidentialLow", "Residential/ResidentialHigh", "Commercial/CommercialLow", "Commercial/CommercialHigh",
           "Industrial/IndustrialGeneric", "Office/OfficeGeneric", "Beautification/None", "Electricity/None", "Water/None",
           "Garbage/None", "HealthCare/None", "FireDepartment/None", "PoliceDepartment/None", "Education/None",
           "PublicTransport/PublicTransportBus", "Monument/None"]
# service buildings placed on the map: (class index, name, weekly upkeep, jobs, coverage field, radius)
SERVICES = [(7, "Wind Turbine", 80, 0, None, 0), (7, "Solar Power Plant", 1200, 40, None, 0), (8, "Water Pumping Station", 320, 0, None, 0),
            (8, "Water Drain Pipe", 320, 0, None, 0), (9, "Incineration Plant", 1440, 30, None, 0), (9, "Landfill Site", 480, 12, None, 0),
            (10, "Medical Clinic", 400, 33, "saudeCob", 900), (10, "Crematorium", 720, 30, "funeraria", 1000),
            (11, "Fire House", 560, 31, "bombeiros", 800), (12, "Police Station", 480, 40, "policia", 800),
            (13, "Elementary School", 160, 26, "fundamental", 600), (13, "High School", 560, 100, "medio", 1300),
            (13, "University", 1920, 126, "superior", 1500), (6, "Small Park", 8, 0, "lazer", 350), (6, "Plaza with Trees", 24, 0, "lazer", 400),
            (14, "Bus Depot", 640, 20, None, 0), (15, "Statue of Industry", 320, 0, "lazer", 500)]
PROBLEMS = ["", "Garbage", "Death", "Noise", "Crime", "Pollution", "NoGoods", "Death, MajorProblem", "Garbage, MajorProblem", "Water", "Abandoned"]
STREETS = ["Harbor", "Mill", "Orchard", "Station", "Foundry", "Canal", "Quarry", "Linden", "Market", "Beacon", "Tanner", "Willow"]


def b64(values):
    return base64.b64encode(bytes(max(0, min(255, int(v))) for v in values)).decode()


class City:
    def __init__(self, seed=7):
        r = self.r = random.Random(seed)
        self.t0 = time.time()
        self.box = [-1600, -1408, 1600, 1408]
        x1, z1, x2, z2 = self.box
        self.river = lambda x: -1050 + 180 * math.sin(x / 520.0)          # centre line of the river (z)
        self.is_water = lambda x, z: abs(z - self.river(x)) < 95
        # road grid: avenues every 480 m, streets every 160 m (x) and 112 m (z), north of the river
        self.kinds = ["Basic Road|Road|8", "Medium Road|Road|16", "Highway|Road|11", "Train Track|PublicTransport|5",
                      "Water Pipe|Water|4.5", "Pedestrian Pavement|Beautification|3", "HighwayRamp|Road|6"]
        xs = list(range(-1280, 1281, 160)); zs = list(range(-784, 1121, 112))
        self.segs, self.streets = [], []
        sid = 0

        def seg(ax, az, bx, bz, kind, name=None, dens=None):
            nonlocal sid
            sid += 1
            if name is not None and name not in self.streets:
                self.streets.append(name)
            d = dens if dens is not None else (r.randint(0, 35) if kind == 0 else r.randint(15, 95) if kind == 1 else r.randint(5, 60))
            self.segs.append([ax, az, (ax + bx) // 2, (az + bz) // 2, bx, bz, kind, d, sid, self.streets.index(name) if name is not None else -1])

        for i, x in enumerate(xs):
            av = i % 3 == 0
            for a, b in zip(zs, zs[1:]):
                seg(x, a, x, b, 1 if av else 0, STREETS[i % len(STREETS)] + (" Avenue" if av else " Street"))
        for j, z in enumerate(zs):
            av = j % 4 == 0
            for a, b in zip(xs, xs[1:]):
                seg(a, z, b, z, 1 if av else 0, STREETS[(j + 5) % len(STREETS)] + (" Boulevard" if av else " Road"))
        for a in range(-4000, 4000, 400):                                   # highway south of the river, edge to edge
            seg(a, -1300, a + 400, -1300 + (40 if a % 800 == 0 else -40), 2, "Riverside Highway", r.randint(10, 70))
        seg(0, -1300, 0, -1000, 6, None, 82); seg(0, -1000, 0, -784, 1, "Harbor Avenue", 91)     # ramp and bridge into town
        for a in range(-4000, 4000, 500):
            seg(a, 1300, a + 500, 1300, 3)
        for x in xs[::2]:
            seg(x, zs[0], x, zs[-1], 4)
        # buildings: lots along both sides of every block
        self.buildings, self.names, bid = [], [], 0
        centre = lambda x, z: math.hypot(x / 1300.0, (z - 170) / 950.0)
        for bx in xs[:-1]:
            for bz in zs[:-1]:
                for row, zz in ((0, bz + 30), (1, bz + 82)):
                    x = bx + 28
                    while x < bx + 140:
                        w = r.choice([2, 2, 3, 4]); d = r.choice([2, 3])
                        cx = x + w * 4
                        if cx + w * 4 > bx + 148:
                            break
                        c = centre(cx, zz)
                        if r.random() < 0.10 + 0.5 * max(0, c - 0.75):       # empty lot
                            x += w * 8 + 2
                            continue
                        east = cx > 800
                        cls = (4 if east and r.random() < 0.8 else 5 if c < 0.3 and r.random() < 0.5 else 3 if c < 0.4 and r.random() < 0.35
                               else 2 if r.random() < 0.08 else 1 if c < 0.55 else 0)
                        bid += 1
                        self.buildings.append({"x": int(cx), "z": int(zz), "ang": 0 if row else 314, "w": w, "d": d, "cls": cls,
                                               "lvl": 1 + min(4 if cls < 2 else 2, int(r.random() * (5 if cls < 2 else 3) * (1.25 - min(1, c)))), "id": bid, "svc": None})
                        x += w * 8 + 2
        # service buildings replace random lots
        self.services = []
        for cls, name, upkeep, jobs, field, radius in SERVICES:
            n = {"Wind Turbine": 6, "Small Park": 14, "Plaza with Trees": 6, "Elementary School": 5, "Medical Clinic": 3, "Fire House": 3,
                 "Police Station": 2, "Crematorium": 1, "Incineration Plant": 2}.get(name, 1)
            for _ in range(n):
                b = r.choice(self.buildings)
                while b["svc"] or (field == "funeraria" and b["x"] > -400):       # the one crematorium sits in the west: the east is out of reach
                    b = r.choice(self.buildings)
                if name not in self.names:
                    self.names.append(name)
                b.update(cls=cls, lvl=1, svc=(name, upkeep, jobs, field, radius), w=min(4, b["w"] + 1))
                self.services.append(b)
        self.lines = [["Bus", "#e34948", [-1120, -112, -640, -112, -160, 112, 320, 112, 640, 448, 160, 560, -480, 336]],
                      ["Metro", "#6250d6", [-960, 784, -320, 448, 320, 112, 960, -224]]]
        self.districts = [["Old Town", -480, 300, 1], ["Foundry Row", 1040, 200, 2], ["Linden Heights", -800, 900, 3]]
        self.district_of = lambda x, z: 2 if x > 800 else 1 if (abs(x + 480) < 520 and abs(z - 300) < 380) else 3 if (x < -300 and z > 700) else 0
        for b in self.buildings:
            self._score(b)

    def _score(self, b):
        r, x, z = self.r, b["x"], b["z"]
        cov = {k: 0 for k in ("saudeCob", "funeraria", "bombeiros", "policia", "fundamental", "medio", "superior", "lazer")}
        for s in self.services:
            _, _, _, field, radius = s["svc"]
            if field:
                d = math.hypot(x - s["x"], z - s["z"])
                if d < radius:
                    cov[field] += int((1 - d / radius) * 220)
        stop = min(math.hypot(x - p[i], z - p[i + 1]) for _, _, p in self.lines for i in range(0, len(p), 2))
        pol = int(max(0, 255 - min(math.hypot(x - o["x"], z - o["z"]) for o in self.buildings if o["cls"] == 4) * 1.6)) if any(o["cls"] == 4 for o in self.buildings) else 0
        zoned = b["cls"] < 6
        prob = 0
        if zoned:
            if cov["funeraria"] == 0 and r.random() < 0.10:
                prob = 7 if r.random() < 0.3 else 2
            elif pol > 120 and b["cls"] < 2:
                prob = 5
            elif r.random() < 0.02:
                prob = r.choice([1, 3, 4, 6, 8, 9])
        b["row"] = [x, z, b["ang"], b["w"], b["d"], b["cls"], b["lvl"], prob, self.names.index(b["svc"][0]) if b["svc"] else -1, pol,
                    max(20, 92 - pol // 6 - (15 if prob else 0) + r.randint(-8, 6)), max(30, 88 - pol // 5 + r.randint(-6, 6)),
                    (r.randint(8, 60) if b["cls"] == 1 else r.randint(2, 6)) if b["cls"] < 2 else r.randint(4, 30),
                    max(3, int(70 - 45 * math.hypot(x / 1300.0, (z - 170) / 950.0) + cov["lazer"] / 20 - pol / 8)), r.randint(0, 40) + (90 if abs(x) % 480 < 60 else 0),
                    cov["bombeiros"], cov["policia"], cov["saudeCob"], cov["funeraria"], cov["fundamental"], cov["medio"], cov["superior"],
                    int(max(0, 300 - stop) * 0.9) if stop < 300 else 0, cov["lazer"], r.randint(0, 12) + (0 if cov["policia"] else 18),
                    r.randint(0, 400) + (2600 if prob in (1, 8) else 0), self.district_of(x, z), b["id"]]

    # ---------- routes ----------
    def weeks(self):
        return int((time.time() - self.t0) / 4)

    def date(self, back=0):
        days = (self.weeks() - back) * 7 + 400 * 7
        y, d = 2030 + days // 364, days % 364
        return "%04d-%02d-%02d" % (y, d // 28 % 12 + 1, d % 28 + 1)

    def terrain(self):
        if getattr(self, "_terrain", None):
            return self._terrain
        x1, z1, x2, z2 = self.box
        step = 32
        nx, nz = (x2 - x1) // step + 1, (z2 - z1) // step + 1
        h, w = [], []
        for j in range(nz):
            for i in range(nx):
                x, z = x1 + i * step, z1 + j * step
                h.append(90 + 80 * math.sin(x / 700.0) * math.cos(z / 520.0) + 40 * math.sin((x + z) / 260.0))
                w.append(1 if self.is_water(x, z) else 0)
        rs = 33.75
        rnx, rnz = int((x2 - x1) / rs) + 1, int((z2 - z1) / rs) + 1
        grid = lambda fn: b64(fn(x1 + i * rs, z1 + j * rs) for j in range(rnz) for i in range(rnx))
        blob = lambda cx, cz, rad: (lambda x, z: 0 if self.is_water(x, z) else max(0, 230 - math.hypot(x - cx, z - cz) / rad * 230))
        ind = [b for b in self.buildings if b["cls"] == 4]
        res = {"passo": rs, "x0": x1, "z0": z1, "nx": rnx, "nz": rnz, "minerio": grid(blob(1100, 900, 500)), "petroleo": grid(lambda x, z: 0),
               "fertil": grid(blob(-900, -300, 900)), "floresta": grid(blob(-1200, 1100, 600)), "arvores": grid(blob(-1200, 1100, 500)),
               "poluicao": grid(lambda x, z: max(0, 255 - min(math.hypot(x - o["x"], z - o["z"]) for o in ind) * 1.6) if ind else 0)}
        gs = 32
        gnx, gnz = (x2 - x1) // gs + 1, (z2 - z1) // gs + 1
        self._terrain = ({"passo": step, "nx": nx, "nz": nz, "hmin": 10, "hmax": 265, "alturas": b64(h), "agua": b64(w), "recursos": res},
                         {"passo": gs, "nx": gnx, "nz": gnz, "distritos": b64(self.district_of(x1 + i * gs, z1 + j * gs) for j in range(gnz) for i in range(gnx))})
        return self._terrain

    def mapa(self):
        terrain, grid = self.terrain()
        wob = math.sin(time.time() / 3.0)

    def dianoite(self):

def page(web):
    index = os.path.join(web, "index.html")
    src = os.path.join(web, "src")
    if os.path.isdir(src):                       # assemble the page the same way build.sh does
        base = open(os.path.join(src, "base.html"), encoding="utf-8").read()
        css = open(os.path.join(src, "estilo.css"), encoding="utf-8").read()
        js = "\n".join(open(f, encoding="utf-8").read() for f in sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(src, "*.js"))))
        return base.replace("/*@@CSS@@*/", css).replace("/*@@JS@@*/", js)
    return open(index, encoding="utf-8").read()


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__, formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter)
    ap.add_argument("--port", type=int, default=19681)
    ap.add_argument("--web", default=os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))), "web"))
    args = ap.parse_args()
    city = City()

    class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
        def do_GET(self):
            path = self.path.split("?")[0]
            route = {"/api/cidade": city.cidade, "/api/mapa": city.mapa, "/api/servicos": city.servicos, "/api/historico": city.historico, "/api/dianoite": city.dianoite}.get(path)
            t0 = time.time()
            if path in ("/", "/index.html"):
                body, kind, code = page(args.web).encode("utf-8"), "text/html; charset=utf-8", 200
            elif route:
                body, kind, code = json.dumps(route(), ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":")).encode("utf-8"), "application/json; charset=utf-8", 200
            else:
                body, kind, code = b'{"erro":"not found"}', "application/json; charset=utf-8", 404
            self.send_response(code)
            self.send_header("Content-Type", kind); self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body))); self.send_header("Cache-Control", "no-store")
            if route:
                self.send_header("X-Coleta-Ms", str(int((time.time() - t0) * 1000)))
            self.end_headers(); self.wfile.write(body)

        def log_message(self, *a):
            pass

    print("mock city at http://127.0.0.1:%d  (page from %s)  Ctrl+C to stop" % (args.port, args.web))
    ThreadingHTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", args.port), Handler).serve_forever()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```

```js
  t.chave = [m.caixa.join(','), amostra(t.alturas), amostra(t.agua), r ? amostra(r.floresta) + amostra(r.arvores) : 0].join('|');   // changes only when the terrain, the water or the forest change
  t.h = b64(t.alturas); t.w = b64(t.agua);
  if (r) ['minerio', 'petroleo', 'fertil', 'floresta', 'arvores', 'poluicao'].forEach(k => r[k] = b64(r[k]));
  const g = m.gradeDistritos;
  if (g) { g.d = g.distritos ? b64(g.distritos) : null; g.p = g.parques ? b64(g.parques) : null; }
  // derived numbers: coverage of zoned buildings, scales (90th percentile) and useful counts
  const x = { cob: {}, cobRes: {}, topo: {}, zon: 0, res: 0, resPoluidos: 0, resBarulho: 0, semBombeiro: 0 };
  const vals = {}; ESCALAVEIS.forEach(k => vals[k] = []);
  COBERTURAS.forEach(k => { x.cob[k] = 0; x.cobRes[k] = 0; });
  for (const b of m.predios) {
    const c = m.cls[b[F.classe]];
    if (!c.zoneado) continue;
    x.zon++;
    const res = c.s === 'Residential';
    if (res) { x.res++; if (b[F.poluicao] >= 40) x.resPoluidos++; if (b[F.ruido] >= 100) x.resBarulho++; }
    for (const k of COBERTURAS) if (b[F[k]] > 0) { x.cob[k]++; if (res) x.cobRes[k]++; }
    for (const k of ESCALAVEIS) if (b[F[k]] > 0) vals[k].push(b[F[k]]);
  }
  for (const k of ESCALAVEIS) { const v = vals[k].sort((a, b) => a - b); x.topo[k] = v.length ? Math.max(1, v[Math.floor(v.length * 0.9)]) : 1; }
  E.x = x;
  return m;
}

// ---------- HTML components for the panel ----------
const ln = (r, v) => `<div class="ln"><span>${r}</span><b>${v}</b></div>`;
function medidor(rotulo, uso, cap, unid, inverso) {
  // inverted: fuller is better (e.g. treatment vs sick does not use this)
  const p = cap > 0 ? uso / cap * 100 : (uso > 0 ? 100 : 0);
  const s = cap <= 0 && uso > 0 ? 3 : p >= 97 ? 3 : p >= 88 ? 2 : p >= 80 ? 1 : 0;
  return `<div class="med"><div class="tp"><b>${rotulo}</b><span>${fmt(uso)} of ${fmt(cap)} ${unid || ''} (${fmt(p)}%)</span></div>
    <div class="tr" role="img" aria-label="${rotulo}: ${fmt(p)}% in use"><i class="s${s}" style="width:${lim(p, 0, 100)}%"></i></div></div>`;
}
function barras(itens, o) {
  o = o || {};
  const max = o.max || Math.max(1, ...itens.map(i => Math.abs(i.v)));
  return '<div class="bars">' + itens.map(i => `<span class="rt" title="${esc(i.r)}">${esc(i.r)}</span>
    <span class="bx" title="${esc(i.r)}: ${o.fmt ? o.fmt(i.v) : fmt(i.v)}"><i style="width:${lim(Math.abs(i.v) / max * 100, 0, 100)}%;background:${i.cor || o.cor || '#3b79a8'}"></i></span>
    <span class="vl">${o.fmt ? o.fmt(i.v) : fmt(i.v)}${i.extra ? ' <small class="nota">' + i.extra + '</small>' : ''}</span>`).join('') + '</div>';
}
function empilhada(partes, o) {
  o = o || {};
  const tot = partes.reduce((a, p) => a + p.v, 0) || 1;
  return `<div class="emp" role="img" aria-label="${esc(partes.map(p => p.r + ' ' + fmt(pc(p.v, tot)) + '%').join(', '))}">` +
    partes.filter(p => p.v > 0).map(p => `<i style="flex:${p.v};background:${p.cor}" title="${esc(p.r)}: ${o.fmt ? o.fmt(p.v) : fmt(p.v)} (${fmt(pc(p.v, tot))}%)"></i>`).join('') + '</div>' +
    '<div class="leg">' + partes.map(p => `<span><i style="background:${p.cor}"></i>${esc(p.r)} ${o.fmt ? o.fmt(p.v) : fmt(p.v)}${o.semPct ? '' : ' (' + fmt(pc(p.v, tot)) + '%)'}</span>`).join('') + '</div>';
}
const SEVN = ['Tip', 'Warning', 'Serious', 'Critical'];
function cartaoSug(s, i) {
  return `<div class="sug s${s.sev}"><h3><em>${SEVN[s.sev]}</em><span>${esc(s.titulo)}</span></h3><p>${s.texto}</p>` +
    (s.foco ? `<button data-foco="${i}">Show on map</button>` : '') + (s.irPara ? `<button data-ir="${s.irPara}">Open ${esc(nomeVisao(s.irPara))}</button>` : '') + '</div>';
}
function sugestoesDe(area) {
  const l = E.sug.map((s, i) => [s, i]).filter(p => p[0].area === area).sort((a, b) => b[0].sev - a[0].sev);
  if (!l.length) return '<h2>Diagnosis</h2><p class="nota">Nothing to point out here right now.</p>';
  return '<h2>Diagnosis and suggestions</h2>' + l.map(p => cartaoSug(p[0], p[1])).join('');
}

// line chart (SVG) with a crosshair and a tooltip on hover
const CORES_SERIE = ['#2a78d6', '#eb6834', '#1baf7a', '#eda100'];
function grafico(id, titulo, series, datas, o) {
  o = o || {};
  const W = 370, H = 120, L = 60, Rg = 8, T = 8, B = 18;
  const todos = [].concat(...series.map(s => s.v)).filter(v => isFinite(v));
  if (datas.length < 2) return `<h2>${titulo}</h2><p class="nota">Not enough points yet: the panel records one sample per in-game week while the game runs.</p>`;
  let mn = o.zero ? 0 : Math.min(...todos), mx = Math.max(...todos);
  if (o.max != null) mx = o.max; if (o.min != null) mn = o.min;
  if (mx === mn) { mx += 1; mn -= o.zero ? 0 : 1; }
  const X = i => L + (W - L - Rg) * i / (datas.length - 1), Y = v => T + (H - T - B) * (1 - (v - mn) / (mx - mn));
  const f = o.fmt || curto;
  let g = '';
  for (let k = 0; k <= 2; k++) { const v = mn + (mx - mn) * k / 2, y = Y(v); g += `<line x1="${L}" x2="${W - Rg}" y1="${y}" y2="${y}" stroke="#d3dee6" stroke-width="1"/><text class="eixo" x="${L - 5}" y="${y + 3.5}" text-anchor="end">${f(v)}</text>`; }
  g += `<text class="eixo" x="${L}" y="${H - 3}">${dataBR(datas[0])}</text><text class="eixo" x="${W - Rg}" y="${H - 3}" text-anchor="end">${dataBR(datas[datas.length - 1])}</text>`;
  series.forEach((s, k) => { g += `<path d="${s.v.map((v, i) => (i ? 'L' : 'M') + X(i).toFixed(1) + ' ' + Y(v).toFixed(1)).join('')}" fill="none" stroke="${s.cor || CORES_SERIE[k]}" stroke-width="2" stroke-linejoin="round"/>`; });
  const leg = series.length > 1 ? '<div class="leg">' + series.map((s, k) => `<span><i style="background:${s.cor || CORES_SERIE[k]}"></i>${esc(s.r)}</span>`).join('') + '</div>' : '';
  GRAFS[id] = { series, datas, X, f, L, W, Rg };
  return `<h2>${titulo}</h2>${leg}<div class="graf" data-graf="${id}"><svg viewBox="0 0 ${W} ${H}" role="img" aria-label="${esc(titulo)}">${g}<line class="regua" y1="${T}" y2="${H - B}" stroke="#14283a" stroke-width="1" visibility="hidden"/></svg><div class="tip" hidden></div></div>`;
}
const GRAFS = {};
/** "Nice" axis limits and step (1, 2, 2.5, 5 × a power of 10). */
function escalaBoa(mn, mx, n) {
  if (mx === mn) mx = mn + 1;
  const bruto = (mx - mn) / n, p = Math.pow(10, Math.floor(Math.log10(bruto))), f = bruto / p, passo = (f <= 1 ? 1 : f <= 2 ? 2 : f <= 2.5 ? 2.5 : f <= 5 ? 5 : 10) * p;
  return { mn: Math.floor(mn / passo + 1e-9) * passo, mx: Math.ceil(mx / passo - 1e-9) * passo, passo };
}
const mesAno = s => { const p = String(s).split('-'); return p.length === 3 ? p[1] + '/' + p[0] : s; };
/** Card with a large line chart, for the charts screen. o.foco = enlarged version (a single chart). */
function graficoGrande(id, titulo, series, datas, o) {
  o = o || {};
  const foco = !!o.foco, W = foco ? 1200 : 640, H = foco ? 430 : 250, L = foco ? 86 : 74, Rg = 18, T = 14, B = 30, f = o.fmt || curto;
  if (datas.length < 2) return `<section class="cartao" data-cartao="${id}"><header><h2>${titulo}</h2></header><p class="nota">Not enough points yet: the panel records one sample per in-game week while the game runs.</p></section>`;
  const todos = [].concat(...series.map(s => s.v)).filter(v => isFinite(v));
  let mn = Math.min(...todos), mx = Math.max(...todos);
  if (o.zero) { mn = Math.min(0, mn); mx = Math.max(0, mx); }
  const e = (o.min != null && o.max != null) ? { mn: o.min, mx: o.max, passo: (o.max - o.min) / 4 } : escalaBoa(mn, mx, 4);
  const n = datas.length, X = i => L + (W - L - Rg) * i / (n - 1), Y = v => T + (H - T - B) * (1 - (lim(v, e.mn, e.mx) - e.mn) / (e.mx - e.mn));
  let g = '';
  for (let v = e.mn; v <= e.mx + e.passo / 1e6; v += e.passo) {
    const y = Y(v).toFixed(1), zero = Math.abs(v) < e.passo / 1e6;
    g += `<line x1="${L}" x2="${W - Rg}" y1="${y}" y2="${y}" stroke="${zero ? '#8fa3b3' : '#dbe4ea'}" stroke-width="1"/><text class="eixo" x="${L - 9}" y="${+y + 4.5}" text-anchor="end">${f(Math.abs(v) < e.passo / 1e6 ? 0 : v)}</text>`;
  }
  const nt = Math.min(foco ? 8 : 5, n);
  for (let k = 0; k < nt; k++) { const i = Math.round(k * (n - 1) / (nt - 1)); g += `<text class="eixo" x="${X(i).toFixed(1)}" y="${H - 8}" text-anchor="${k === 0 ? 'start' : k === nt - 1 ? 'end' : 'middle'}">${mesAno(datas[i])}</text>`; }
  const base = Y(lim(0, e.mn, e.mx)).toFixed(1);
  series.forEach((s, k) => {
    const cor = s.cor || CORES_SERIE[k], d = s.v.map((v, i) => (i ? 'L' : 'M') + X(i).toFixed(1) + ' ' + Y(v).toFixed(1)).join('');
    if (series.length === 1) g += `<path d="${d}L${X(n - 1).toFixed(1)} ${base}L${X(0).toFixed(1)} ${base}Z" fill="${cor}" opacity=".1"/>`;
    g += `<path d="${d}" fill="none" stroke="${cor}" stroke-width="${foco ? 3 : 2.5}" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-linecap="round"/>`;
    g += `<circle cx="${X(n - 1).toFixed(1)}" cy="${Y(s.v[n - 1]).toFixed(1)}" r="${foco ? 5 : 4}" fill="${cor}" stroke="#fff" stroke-width="2"/>`;
  });
  let cab, leg = '';
  if (series.length === 1) {
    const a = series[0].v[0], b = series[0].v[n - 1], dif = b - a;
    cab = `<div class="agora"><b>${f(b)}</b><span>${dif === 0 ? 'no change' : (dif > 0 ? '▲ ' : '▼ ') + f(Math.abs(dif))} since ${mesAno(datas[0])}</span></div>`;
  } else {
    cab = '';
    leg = '<div class="leg">' + series.map((s, k) => `<span><i style="background:${s.cor || CORES_SERIE[k]}"></i>${esc(s.r)}<b>${f(s.v[n - 1])}</b></span>`).join('') + '</div>';
  }
  GRAFS[id] = { series, datas, X, f, L, W, Rg };
  return `<section class="cartao" data-cartao="${id}" title="${foco ? 'Click to go back to all charts' : 'Click to enlarge'}"><header><h2>${titulo}</h2>${cab}</header>${leg}<div class="graf grande" data-graf="${id}"><svg viewBox="0 0 ${W} ${H}" role="img" aria-label="${esc(titulo)}">${g}<line class="regua" y1="${T}" y2="${H - B}" stroke="#14283a" stroke-width="1" visibility="hidden"/></svg><div class="tip" hidden></div></div></section>`;
}
document.addEventListener('pointermove', ev => {
  const el = ev.target.closest && ev.target.closest('.graf');
  document.querySelectorAll('.graf .tip').forEach(t => { if (!el || t.parentNode !== el) { t.hidden = true; t.parentNode.querySelector('.regua').setAttribute('visibility', 'hidden'); } });
  if (!el) return;
  const G = GRAFS[el.dataset.graf]; if (!G) return;
  const r = el.querySelector('svg').getBoundingClientRect();
  const vx = (ev.clientX - r.left) / r.width * G.W;
  const i = lim(Math.round((vx - G.L) / (G.W - G.L - G.Rg) * (G.datas.length - 1)), 0, G.datas.length - 1);
  const rg = el.querySelector('.regua'); rg.setAttribute('x1', G.X(i)); rg.setAttribute('x2', G.X(i)); rg.setAttribute('visibility', 'visible');
  const tip = el.querySelector('.tip'); tip.hidden = false;
  tip.innerHTML = '<b>' + dataBR(G.datas[i]) + '</b> ' + G.series.map(s => esc(s.r) + ' ' + G.f(s.v[i])).join(' | ');
  const px = G.X(i) / G.W * r.width;
  tip.style.left = lim(px - tip.offsetWidth / 2, 0, r.width - tip.offsetWidth) + 'px';
});
```

```js
function hex(c) { return [parseInt(c.substr(1, 2), 16), parseInt(c.substr(3, 2), 16), parseInt(c.substr(5, 2), 16)]; }
function mist(a, b, t) { return [a[0] + (b[0] - a[0]) * t, a[1] + (b[1] - a[1]) * t, a[2] + (b[2] - a[2]) * t]; }

/** Shaded relief + water + forest, in an image the size of the terrain grid. */
function montarBase() {
  const t = E.m.terreno, r = t.recursos, natural = V().modo === 'zonas';
  const chave = natural + '|' + t.chave;
  if (M.base && M.baseChave === chave) return;
  M.baseChave = chave;
  const c = document.createElement('canvas'); c.width = t.nx; c.height = t.nz;
  const g = c.getContext('2d'), im = g.createImageData(t.nx, t.nz), d = im.data;
  const baixo = hex(natural ? '#cddcb2' : '#e4e6e0'), alto = hex(natural ? '#ebe3c9' : '#f1f0ea'), mata = hex(natural ? '#86ad72' : '#cdd6c6'), agua = hex(natural ? '#8cc0e4' : '#bfd3e2'), aguaF = hex(natural ? '#6aa6d6' : '#aac4d8');
  const esc = (t.hmax - t.hmin) / 255, x1 = E.m.caixa[0], z1 = E.m.caixa[1];
  const H = (a, b) => t.h[lim(b, 0, t.nz - 1) * t.nx + lim(a, 0, t.nx - 1)] * esc;
  for (let b = 0; b < t.nz; b++) for (let a = 0; a < t.nx; a++) {
    const i = b * t.nx + a, o = i * 4;
    let cor;
    if (t.w[i]) {
      // lighter shore: counts land neighbours
      const borda = !t.w[lim(b, 0, t.nz - 1) * t.nx + lim(a - 1, 0, t.nx - 1)] || !t.w[lim(b, 0, t.nz - 1) * t.nx + lim(a + 1, 0, t.nx - 1)] || !t.w[lim(b - 1, 0, t.nz - 1) * t.nx + a] || !t.w[lim(b + 1, 0, t.nz - 1) * t.nx + a];
      cor = borda ? agua : aguaF;
    } else {
      cor = mist(baixo, alto, lim(t.h[i] / 150, 0, 1));
      if (r) {
        const rx = Math.floor((x1 + a * t.passo - r.x0) / r.passo), rz = Math.floor((z1 + b * t.passo - r.z0) / r.passo);
        if (rx >= 0 && rz >= 0 && rx < r.nx && rz < r.nz) { const f = Math.max(r.floresta[rz * r.nx + rx], r.arvores[rz * r.nx + rx]) / 255; if (f > 0.04) cor = mist(cor, mata, lim(f * 1.6, 0, 0.9)); }
      }
      const dx = (H(a + 1, b) - H(a - 1, b)) / (2 * t.passo), dz = (H(a, b + 1) - H(a, b - 1)) / (2 * t.passo);
      const s = lim(1 + (dz - dx) * 0.9, 0.72, 1.16);   // light coming from the north-west
      cor = [cor[0] * s, cor[1] * s, cor[2] * s];
    }
    d[o] = cor[0]; d[o + 1] = cor[1]; d[o + 2] = cor[2]; d[o + 3] = 255;
  }
  g.putImageData(im, 0, 0);
  M.base = c;
}

/** Grid layer of the view: natural resource, ground pollution or district areas. */
function montarGrade() {
```
