`examples/shadow-of-war-offline-mode/src/offline.c`:

```c
/* Shadow of War Offline Mode: winhttp.dll proxy.
 *
 * The game's online layer (WB/Agora "Hydra" SDK) talks to WB's servers through WinHTTP in async mode.
 * This DLL sits next to ShadowOfWar.exe and forwards every WinHTTP call to the real System32 winhttp.dll,
 * except for WB/Agora hosts. Those never reach the network:
 *   Mode=block    each request fails like an unreachable server (REQUEST_ERROR / ERROR_WINHTTP_CANNOT_CONNECT).
 *   Mode=emulate  each request is answered locally by responder.c (a minimal stand-in for WB's server, so
 *                 offline-capable features such as the Garrison can work from a local file).
 * Requests are logged to OfflineMode.log (sign-in bodies and auth headers are redacted). The exe is never modified.
 */
#define WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
#include <windows.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <wchar.h>
#include "names.h"
#include "agb.h"
#include "responder.h"

typedef void *HINTERNET;
typedef void (CALLBACK *STATUS_CB)(HINTERNET, DWORD_PTR, DWORD, LPVOID, DWORD);
typedef struct { DWORD_PTR dwResult; DWORD dwError; } ASYNC_RESULT;

#define FLAG_ASYNC                 0x10000000
#define CB_HANDLE_CLOSING          0x00000800
#define CB_HEADERS_AVAILABLE       0x00020000
#define CB_DATA_AVAILABLE          0x00040000
#define CB_READ_COMPLETE           0x00080000
#define CB_REQUEST_ERROR           0x00200000
#define CB_SENDREQUEST_COMPLETE    0x00400000
#define API_SEND_REQUEST           5
#define ERR_CANNOT_CONNECT         12029
#define ERR_INCORRECT_HANDLE_STATE 12019
#define ERR_HEADER_NOT_FOUND       12150
#define QUERY_FLAG_NUMBER          0x20000000
#define QUERY_CONTENT_TYPE         1
#define QUERY_CONTENT_LENGTH       5
#define QUERY_STATUS_CODE          19
#define QUERY_STATUS_TEXT          20
#define QUERY_RAW_HEADERS          21
#define QUERY_RAW_HEADERS_CRLF     22
#define QUERY_CUSTOM               65535
#define INVALID_CB                 ((STATUS_CB)(LONG_PTR)-1)

extern void *real_ptrs[REAL_COUNT];

HINTERNET WINAPI Real_WinHttpOpen(LPCWSTR, DWORD, LPCWSTR, LPCWSTR, DWORD);
HINTERNET WINAPI Real_WinHttpConnect(HINTERNET, LPCWSTR, WORD, DWORD);
HINTERNET WINAPI Real_WinHttpOpenRequest(HINTERNET, LPCWSTR, LPCWSTR, LPCWSTR, LPCWSTR, LPCWSTR *, DWORD);
BOOL WINAPI Real_WinHttpAddRequestHeaders(HINTERNET, LPCWSTR, DWORD, DWORD);
BOOL WINAPI Real_WinHttpSendRequest(HINTERNET, LPCWSTR, DWORD, LPVOID, DWORD, DWORD, DWORD_PTR);
BOOL WINAPI Real_WinHttpReceiveResponse(HINTERNET, LPVOID);
BOOL WINAPI Real_WinHttpQueryHeaders(HINTERNET, DWORD, LPCWSTR, LPVOID, LPDWORD, LPDWORD);
BOOL WINAPI Real_WinHttpReadData(HINTERNET, LPVOID, DWORD, LPDWORD);
BOOL WINAPI Real_WinHttpQueryDataAvailable(HINTERNET, LPDWORD);
BOOL WINAPI Real_WinHttpWriteData(HINTERNET, LPCVOID, DWORD, LPDWORD);
BOOL WINAPI Real_WinHttpSetTimeouts(HINTERNET, int, int, int, int);
STATUS_CB WINAPI Real_WinHttpSetStatusCallback(HINTERNET, STATUS_CB, DWORD, DWORD_PTR);
BOOL WINAPI Real_WinHttpCloseHandle(HINTERNET);
BOOL WINAPI Real_WinHttpSetOption(HINTERNET, DWORD, LPVOID, DWORD);
BOOL WINAPI Real_WinHttpQueryOption(HINTERNET, DWORD, LPVOID, LPDWORD);

/* ---------- state ---------- */
typedef struct Sess { HINTERNET h; BOOL async; STATUS_CB cb; DWORD flags; struct Sess *next; } Sess;
typedef struct Fake {
    DWORD magic; int kind; /* 1 = connect, 2 = request */
    HINTERNET session;
    STATUS_CB cb; DWORD flags; BOOL async; DWORD_PTR ctx;
    volatile LONG inflight; DWORD cbThread; volatile LONG dead;  /* callbacks running / closed inside one */
    WCHAR host[256]; WCHAR verb[16]; WCHAR path[1024];
    unsigned char *req; size_t reqLen;                            /* request body */
    Response resp; size_t readPos; BOOL haveResp;                  /* emulated response */
    DWORD readLeft;                                               /* bytes of the current async read */
    struct Fake *next;
} Fake;

static CRITICAL_SECTION cs;
static Sess *sessions;
static Fake *fakes;
static FILE *logf;
static WCHAR blocked[32][64];
static int nblocked;
static BOOL emulate;

void logw(const wchar_t *fmt, ...)
{
    if (!logf) return;
    SYSTEMTIME t; GetLocalTime(&t);
    EnterCriticalSection(&cs);
    fwprintf(logf, L"%02d:%02d:%02d.%03d ", t.wHour, t.wMinute, t.wSecond, t.wMilliseconds);
    va_list a; va_start(a, fmt); vfwprintf(logf, fmt, a); va_end(a);
    fputwc(L'\n', logf); fflush(logf);
    LeaveCriticalSection(&cs);
}

static Sess *find_sess(HINTERNET h) { Sess *s; for (s = sessions; s; s = s->next) if (s->h == h) return s; return NULL; }
static Fake *find_fake_locked(HINTERNET h) { Fake *f; for (f = fakes; f; f = f->next) if ((HINTERNET)f == h) break; return f; }
static Fake *find_fake(HINTERNET h) { EnterCriticalSection(&cs); Fake *f = find_fake_locked(h); LeaveCriticalSection(&cs); return f; }

static BOOL is_blocked(LPCWSTR host)
{
    if (!host) return FALSE;
    size_t hl = wcslen(host);
    for (int i = 0; i < nblocked; i++) {
        size_t bl = wcslen(blocked[i]);
        if (hl < bl || _wcsicmp(host + hl - bl, blocked[i])) continue;
        if (hl == bl || host[hl - bl - 1] == L'.') return TRUE; /* exact or subdomain */
    }
    return FALSE;
}

static BOOL is_signin(const Fake *f) { return wcsstr(f->path, L"auth") || wcsstr(f->path, L"access"); }

/* log a body: decoded if it's x-ag-binary, else printable/escaped */
static void log_body(const char *label, const void *p, size_t n)
{
    if (!p || !n) return;
    size_t cap = 16384; char *txt = malloc(cap);
    if (agb_to_text(p, n, txt, cap)) { logw(L"    %hs (%zu bytes): %hs", label, n, txt); free(txt); return; }
    const unsigned char *b = p; size_t m = n > 4096 ? 4096 : n, o = 0;
    static const char hx[] = "0123456789ABCDEF";
    for (size_t i = 0; i < m && o + 5 < cap; i++) {
        if (b[i] >= 32 && b[i] < 127 && b[i] != '\\') txt[o++] = b[i];
        else { txt[o++] = '\\'; txt[o++] = 'x'; txt[o++] = hx[b[i] >> 4]; txt[o++] = hx[b[i] & 15]; }
    }
    txt[o] = 0;
    logw(L"    %hs (%zu bytes, raw%ls): %hs", label, n, n > m ? L", first 4096" : L"", txt);
    free(txt);
}

static void log_headers(LPCWSTR hdr, DWORD len)
{
    if (!hdr) return;
    size_t n = (len == (DWORD)-1) ? wcslen(hdr) : len;
    wchar_t *c = malloc((n + 1) * sizeof(wchar_t)); wcsncpy(c, hdr, n); c[n] = 0;
    for (wchar_t *line = c, *e; line && *line; line = e) {
        e = wcsstr(line, L"\r\n"); if (e) { *e = 0; e += 2; }
        if (!*line) continue;
        wchar_t *colon = wcschr(line, L':');
        if (colon && (!_wcsnicmp(line, L"Authorization", 13) || !_wcsnicmp(line, L"x-hydra-access-token", 20) || !_wcsnicmp(line, L"Cookie", 6)))
            logw(L"    header %.*ls: <redacted>", (int)(colon - line), line);
        else logw(L"    header %ls", line);
    }
    free(c);
}

/* ---------- async callbacks (always from a worker thread, like real WinHTTP) ---------- */
typedef struct { Fake *f; DWORD status; DWORD_PTR ctx; void *info; DWORD len; unsigned char inl[32]; int useInl; } Job;

static DWORD WINAPI cb_thread(LPVOID p)
{
    Job *j = p; STATUS_CB cb = NULL;
    Sleep(1);
    EnterCriticalSection(&cs);
    Fake *f = find_fake_locked((HINTERNET)j->f);
    if (f && !f->dead && f->cb && f->cb != INVALID_CB && (f->flags & j->status)) {
        cb = f->cb; f->cbThread = GetCurrentThreadId(); InterlockedIncrement(&f->inflight);
    }
    LeaveCriticalSection(&cs);
    if (cb) {
        cb((HINTERNET)f, j->ctx, j->status, j->useInl ? (void *)j->inl : j->info, j->len);
        if (InterlockedDecrement(&f->inflight) == 0 && f->dead) { free(f->req); resp_free(&f->resp); free(f); }
    }
    free(j);
    return 0;
}

static BOOL post_cb(Fake *f, DWORD status, void *info, DWORD len, BOOL copy)
{
    if (!f->cb || f->cb == INVALID_CB || !(f->flags & status)) return FALSE;
    Job *j = calloc(1, sizeof *j); j->f = f; j->status = status; j->ctx = f->ctx; j->len = len;
    if (copy && info && len <= sizeof j->inl) { memcpy(j->inl, info, len); j->useInl = 1; } else j->info = info;
    HANDLE t = CreateThread(NULL, 0, cb_thread, j, 0, NULL);
    if (!t) { free(j); return FALSE; }
    CloseHandle(t);
    return TRUE;
}

/* ---------- hooked exports ---------- */
HINTERNET WINAPI WinHttpOpen(LPCWSTR agent, DWORD access, LPCWSTR proxy, LPCWSTR bypass, DWORD flags)
{
    HINTERNET h = Real_WinHttpOpen(agent, access, proxy, bypass, flags);
    if (h) {
        Sess *s = calloc(1, sizeof *s); s->h = h; s->async = (flags & FLAG_ASYNC) != 0;
        EnterCriticalSection(&cs); s->next = sessions; sessions = s; LeaveCriticalSection(&cs);
    }
    logw(L"WinHttpOpen agent=\"%ls\" async=%d -> %p", agent ? agent : L"", (flags & FLAG_ASYNC) != 0, h);
    return h;
}

HINTERNET WINAPI WinHttpConnect(HINTERNET session, LPCWSTR host, WORD port, DWORD reserved)
{
    if (!is_blocked(host)) {
        HINTERNET h = Real_WinHttpConnect(session, host, port, reserved);
        logw(L"connect %ls:%u (allowed) -> %p", host ? host : L"?", port, h);
        return h;
    }
    Fake *f = calloc(1, sizeof *f); f->magic = 'OFFL'; f->kind = 1; f->session = session;
    EnterCriticalSection(&cs);
    Sess *s = find_sess(session);
    if (s) { f->async = s->async; f->cb = s->cb; f->flags = s->flags; }
    f->next = fakes; fakes = f;
    LeaveCriticalSection(&cs);
    wcsncpy(f->host, host, 255);
    logw(L"connect %ls:%u %ls -> local %p", host, port, emulate ? L"EMULATED" : L"BLOCKED", f);
    return (HINTERNET)f;
}

HINTERNET WINAPI WinHttpOpenRequest(HINTERNET c, LPCWSTR verb, LPCWSTR path, LPCWSTR ver, LPCWSTR ref, LPCWSTR *types, DWORD flags)
{
    Fake *p = find_fake(c);
    if (!p) return Real_WinHttpOpenRequest(c, verb, path, ver, ref, types, flags);
    Fake *f = calloc(1, sizeof *f); f->magic = 'OFFL'; f->kind = 2; f->session = p->session;
    f->async = p->async; f->cb = p->cb; f->flags = p->flags;
    wcsncpy(f->host, p->host, 255);
    wcsncpy(f->verb, verb ? verb : L"GET", 15);
    wcsncpy(f->path, path ? path : L"/", 1023);
    EnterCriticalSection(&cs); f->next = fakes; fakes = f; LeaveCriticalSection(&cs);
    return (HINTERNET)f;
}

BOOL WINAPI WinHttpAddRequestHeaders(HINTERNET r, LPCWSTR hdr, DWORD len, DWORD mod)
{
    Fake *f = find_fake(r);
    if (!f) return Real_WinHttpAddRequestHeaders(r, hdr, len, mod);
    return TRUE; /* logged with the send */
}

BOOL WINAPI WinHttpSendRequest(HINTERNET r, LPCWSTR hdr, DWORD hlen, LPVOID opt, DWORD olen, DWORD total, DWORD_PTR ctx)
{
    Fake *f = find_fake(r);
    if (!f) return Real_WinHttpSendRequest(r, hdr, hlen, opt, olen, total, ctx);
    f->ctx = ctx;
    if (olen && opt) { f->req = malloc(olen); memcpy(f->req, opt, olen); f->reqLen = olen; }
    logw(L"%ls %ls  [%ls]", f->verb, f->path, f->host);
    log_headers(hdr, hlen);
    if (is_signin(f)) { if (olen) logw(L"    request (%lu bytes): <sign-in, redacted>", olen); }
    else log_body("request", opt, olen);

    if (emulate) {
        respond(f->verb, f->path, f->req, f->reqLen, &f->resp);
        f->haveResp = TRUE; f->readPos = 0;
        logw(L"    -> %d (%zu bytes)", f->resp.status, f->resp.len);
        if (!is_signin(f)) log_body("response", f->resp.body, f->resp.len);
        if (f->async && post_cb(f, CB_SENDREQUEST_COMPLETE, NULL, 0, FALSE)) return TRUE;
        return TRUE; /* sync, or the game didn't ask for the notification */
    }

    if (f->async) {
        ASYNC_RESULT res = { API_SEND_REQUEST, ERR_CANNOT_CONNECT };
        if (post_cb(f, CB_REQUEST_ERROR, &res, sizeof res, TRUE)) return TRUE;
    }
    SetLastError(ERR_CANNOT_CONNECT);
    return FALSE;
}

BOOL WINAPI WinHttpWriteData(HINTERNET r, LPCVOID b, DWORD n, LPDWORD w)
{
    if (!find_fake(r)) return Real_WinHttpWriteData(r, b, n, w);
    SetLastError(ERR_INCORRECT_HANDLE_STATE); return FALSE;
}

BOOL WINAPI WinHttpReceiveResponse(HINTERNET r, LPVOID x)
{
    Fake *f = find_fake(r);
    if (!f) return Real_WinHttpReceiveResponse(r, x);
    if (!f->haveResp) { SetLastError(ERR_INCORRECT_HANDLE_STATE); return FALSE; }
    if (f->async) post_cb(f, CB_HEADERS_AVAILABLE, NULL, 0, FALSE);
    return TRUE;
}

/* the emulated response's headers, as WinHTTP would report them */
static void header_text(Fake *f, DWORD level, LPCWSTR name, WCHAR *out, size_t cap, BOOL *found)
{
    *found = TRUE; out[0] = 0;
    switch (level) {
    case QUERY_STATUS_CODE: _snwprintf(out, cap, L"%d", f->resp.status); break;
    case QUERY_STATUS_TEXT: _snwprintf(out, cap, L"%ls", f->resp.status == 200 ? L"OK" : L"Error"); break;
    case QUERY_CONTENT_TYPE: _snwprintf(out, cap, L"application/x-ag-binary"); break;
    case QUERY_CONTENT_LENGTH: _snwprintf(out, cap, L"%zu", f->resp.len); break;
    case QUERY_RAW_HEADERS_CRLF:
        _snwprintf(out, cap, L"HTTP/1.1 %d %ls\r\nContent-Type: application/x-ag-binary\r\nContent-Length: %zu\r\n\r\n",
                   f->resp.status, f->resp.status == 200 ? L"OK" : L"Error", f->resp.len); break;
    case QUERY_CUSTOM:
        if (name && !_wcsicmp(name, L"Content-Type")) _snwprintf(out, cap, L"application/x-ag-binary");
        else *found = FALSE;
        break;
    default: *found = FALSE;
    }
    out[cap - 1] = 0;
}

BOOL WINAPI WinHttpQueryHeaders(HINTERNET r, DWORD info, LPCWSTR name, LPVOID buf, LPDWORD blen, LPDWORD idx)
{
    Fake *f = find_fake(r);
    if (!f) return Real_WinHttpQueryHeaders(r, info, name, buf, blen, idx);
    if (!f->haveResp) { SetLastError(ERR_INCORRECT_HANDLE_STATE); return FALSE; }
    WCHAR txt[512]; BOOL found;
    if ((info & 0xFFFF) == QUERY_RAW_HEADERS) { /* NUL-separated lines, double-NUL terminated */
        header_text(f, QUERY_RAW_HEADERS_CRLF, NULL, txt, 512, &found);
        DWORD n = 0;
        for (WCHAR *s = txt; *s; s++) { if (s[0] == L'\r' && s[1] == L'\n') { txt[n++] = 0; s++; } else txt[n++] = *s; }
        while (n >= 2 && txt[n - 1] == 0 && txt[n - 2] == 0) n--; /* the CRLF form ends with an empty line */
        txt[n++] = 0;
        DWORD need = n * sizeof(WCHAR);
        if (!buf || !blen || *blen < need) { if (blen) *blen = need; SetLastError(ERROR_INSUFFICIENT_BUFFER); return FALSE; }
        memcpy(buf, txt, need); *blen = need - sizeof(WCHAR);
        return TRUE;
    }
    header_text(f, info & 0xFFFF, name, txt, 512, &found);
    if (!found) { logw(L"    (game asked for header level %lu %ls: not present)", info & 0xFFFF, name ? name : L""); SetLastError(ERR_HEADER_NOT_FOUND); return FALSE; }
    if (info & QUERY_FLAG_NUMBER) {
        if (!buf || !blen || *blen < sizeof(DWORD)) { if (blen) *blen = sizeof(DWORD); SetLastError(ERROR_INSUFFICIENT_BUFFER); return FALSE; }
        *(DWORD *)buf = wcstoul(txt, NULL, 10); *blen = sizeof(DWORD);
        return TRUE;
    }
    DWORD need = (DWORD)((wcslen(txt) + 1) * sizeof(WCHAR));
    if (!buf || !blen || *blen < need) { if (blen) *blen = need; SetLastError(ERROR_INSUFFICIENT_BUFFER); return FALSE; }
    memcpy(buf, txt, need); *blen = need - sizeof(WCHAR);
    return TRUE;
}

BOOL WINAPI WinHttpQueryDataAvailable(HINTERNET r, LPDWORD n)
{
    Fake *f = find_fake(r);
    if (!f) return Real_WinHttpQueryDataAvailable(r, n);
    if (!f->haveResp) { SetLastError(ERR_INCORRECT_HANDLE_STATE); return FALSE; }
    DWORD avail = (DWORD)(f->resp.len - f->readPos);
    if (n) *n = avail;
    if (f->async) post_cb(f, CB_DATA_AVAILABLE, &avail, sizeof avail, TRUE);
    return TRUE;
}

BOOL WINAPI WinHttpReadData(HINTERNET r, LPVOID b, DWORD n, LPDWORD rd)
{
    Fake *f = find_fake(r);
    if (!f) return Real_WinHttpReadData(r, b, n, rd);
    if (!f->haveResp) { SetLastError(ERR_INCORRECT_HANDLE_STATE); return FALSE; }
    size_t left = f->resp.len - f->readPos;
    DWORD c = (DWORD)(left < n ? left : n);
    if (c) memcpy(b, f->resp.body + f->readPos, c);
    f->readPos += c;
    if (rd) *rd = c;
    if (f->async) post_cb(f, CB_READ_COMPLETE, b, c, FALSE); /* info = the caller's buffer, length = bytes read */
    return TRUE;
}

BOOL WINAPI WinHttpQueryOption(HINTERNET h, DWORD o, LPVOID b, LPDWORD n)
{
    Fake *f = find_fake(h);
    if (!f) return Real_WinHttpQueryOption(h, o, b, n);
    if (o == 45 /* CONTEXT_VALUE */ && b && n && *n >= sizeof(DWORD_PTR)) { *(DWORD_PTR *)b = f->ctx; *n = sizeof(DWORD_PTR); return TRUE; }
    SetLastError(ERR_INCORRECT_HANDLE_STATE); return FALSE;
}

BOOL WINAPI WinHttpSetTimeouts(HINTERNET h, int a, int b, int c, int d)
{
    if (find_fake(h)) return TRUE;
    return Real_WinHttpSetTimeouts(h, a, b, c, d);
}

BOOL WINAPI WinHttpSetOption(HINTERNET h, DWORD o, LPVOID b, DWORD n)
{
    Fake *f = find_fake(h);
    if (f) { if (o == 45 /* CONTEXT_VALUE */ && b && n >= sizeof(DWORD_PTR)) f->ctx = *(DWORD_PTR *)b; return TRUE; }
    return Real_WinHttpSetOption(h, o, b, n);
}

STATUS_CB WINAPI WinHttpSetStatusCallback(HINTERNET h, STATUS_CB cb, DWORD flags, DWORD_PTR reserved)
{
    Fake *f = find_fake(h);
    if (f) { STATUS_CB old = f->cb; f->cb = cb; f->flags = flags; return old; }
    STATUS_CB old = Real_WinHttpSetStatusCallback(h, cb, flags, reserved);
    EnterCriticalSection(&cs);
    Sess *s = find_sess(h);
    if (s && old != INVALID_CB) { s->cb = cb; s->flags = flags; }
    LeaveCriticalSection(&cs);
    return old;
}

BOOL WINAPI WinHttpCloseHandle(HINTERNET h)
{
    Fake *f = find_fake(h);
    if (!f) {
        EnterCriticalSection(&cs);
        for (Sess **pp = &sessions; *pp; pp = &(*pp)->next) if ((*pp)->h == h) { Sess *s = *pp; *pp = s->next; free(s); break; }
        LeaveCriticalSection(&cs);
        return Real_WinHttpCloseHandle(h);
    }
    if (f->cb && f->cb != INVALID_CB && (f->flags & CB_HANDLE_CLOSING)) {
        HINTERNET hv = h;
        f->cb(h, f->ctx, CB_HANDLE_CLOSING, &hv, sizeof hv);
    }
    EnterCriticalSection(&cs);
    for (Fake **pp = &fakes; *pp; pp = &(*pp)->next) if (*pp == f) { *pp = f->next; break; }
    f->dead = 1;
    LeaveCriticalSection(&cs);
    if (f->inflight) {
        if (f->cbThread == GetCurrentThreadId()) return TRUE; /* closed inside its own callback: cb_thread frees it */
        while (f->inflight) Sleep(1);
    }
    free(f->req); resp_free(&f->resp); free(f);
    return TRUE;
}

/* ---------- crash reporter ----------
 * On an access violation in the game module, log the faulting address and the return addresses found on the
 * stack (exe-relative, so they match the Ghidra project at base 0x140000000), then let the crash proceed. */
static LONG CALLBACK crash_report(PEXCEPTION_POINTERS ep)
{
    static volatile LONG count;
    if (ep->ExceptionRecord->ExceptionCode != EXCEPTION_ACCESS_VIOLATION) return EXCEPTION_CONTINUE_SEARCH;
    HMODULE exe = GetModuleHandleW(NULL);
    ULONG_PTR lo = (ULONG_PTR)exe, hi = lo + 0x8000000, rip = ep->ContextRecord->Rip;
    if (rip < lo || rip >= hi || InterlockedIncrement(&count) > 20) return EXCEPTION_CONTINUE_SEARCH; /* the last one logged is the fatal one */
    logw(L"CRASH: access violation at exe+0x%llX (0x%llX), %ls address 0x%llX; rcx=0x%llX rdx=0x%llX",
         (unsigned long long)(rip - lo), (unsigned long long)(rip - lo + 0x140000000ULL),
         ep->ExceptionRecord->ExceptionInformation[0] ? L"writing" : L"reading",
         (unsigned long long)ep->ExceptionRecord->ExceptionInformation[1],
         (unsigned long long)ep->ContextRecord->Rcx, (unsigned long long)ep->ContextRecord->Rdx);
    ULONG_PTR *sp = (ULONG_PTR *)ep->ContextRecord->Rsp;
    int found = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < 2048 && found < 16; i++) {
        ULONG_PTR v;
        if (IsBadReadPtr(sp + i, sizeof v)) break;
        v = sp[i];
        if (v > lo + 0x1000 && v < hi) { logw(L"  stack[%d] 0x%llX", i, (unsigned long long)(v - lo + 0x140000000ULL)); found++; }
    }
    return EXCEPTION_CONTINUE_SEARCH;
}

/* ---------- setup ---------- */
static void load_config(HMODULE self)
{
    WCHAR dir[MAX_PATH], ini[MAX_PATH], logp[MAX_PATH], list[2048], mode[32];
    GetModuleFileNameW(self, dir, MAX_PATH);
    WCHAR *slash = wcsrchr(dir, L'\\'); if (slash) slash[1] = 0;
    _snwprintf(ini, MAX_PATH, L"%lsOfflineMode.ini", dir);
    _snwprintf(logp, MAX_PATH, L"%lsOfflineMode.log", dir);
    GetPrivateProfileStringW(L"Offline", L"BlockedDomains",
        L"wbagora.com,agoragames.com,wbgames.com,turbine.com,wbplay.com,wbidams.com", list, 2048, ini);
    for (WCHAR *ctx = NULL, *t = wcstok(list, L", ", &ctx); t && nblocked < 32; t = wcstok(NULL, L", ", &ctx))
        wcsncpy(blocked[nblocked++], t, 63);
    GetPrivateProfileStringW(L"Offline", L"Mode", L"emulate", mode, 32, ini);
    emulate = _wcsicmp(mode, L"block") != 0;
    if (GetPrivateProfileIntW(L"Offline", L"Log", 1, ini)) logf = _wfopen(logp, L"w, ccs=UTF-8");
    WCHAR data[MAX_PATH]; _snwprintf(data, MAX_PATH, L"%lsOfflineGarrison.dat", dir);
    { extern int storePlaceholders; storePlaceholders = GetPrivateProfileIntW(L"Offline", L"StorePlaceholders", 1, ini); }
    responder_init(data, GetPrivateProfileIntW(L"Offline", L"GarrisonSize", 50, ini));
    logw(L"Shadow of War Offline Mode, mode=%ls. WB/Agora hosts never reach the network:", emulate ? L"emulate" : L"block");
    for (int i = 0; i < nblocked; i++) logw(L"  *.%ls", blocked[i]);
}

BOOL WINAPI DllMain(HINSTANCE inst, DWORD reason, LPVOID res)
{
    if (reason == DLL_PROCESS_ATTACH) {
        DisableThreadLibraryCalls(inst);
        InitializeCriticalSection(&cs);
        WCHAR sys[MAX_PATH]; GetSystemDirectoryW(sys, MAX_PATH); wcscat(sys, L"\\winhttp.dll");
        HMODULE real = LoadLibraryW(sys);
        if (!real) return FALSE;
        for (int i = 0; i < REAL_COUNT; i++) real_ptrs[i] = (void *)GetProcAddress(real, real_names[i]);
        load_config(inst);
        AddVectoredExceptionHandler(0, crash_report); /* last in line: only reports, never handles */
    }
    return TRUE;
}

```

`examples/shadow-of-war-offline-mode/src/responder.c`:

```c
/* Local stand-in for WB's Hydra server. Only what the single-player game needs to treat itself as signed in
 * offline: no account data leaves the PC, nothing here is sent anywhere, and no purchasable items are created.
 *
 * Known from the client (build 3095001):
 *   POST /auth    body {fail_on_missing, steam: <ticket>}  -> {token, type}       (handler 0x14095FF30)
 *   POST /access  body {auth_token, options, metadata}     -> {token, <key>: ...} (handler 0x14095FC20; any extra
 *                 top-level key is passed to a handler registered under that name, unknown keys are skipped)
 * Every other request currently gets 200 + an empty map and is logged, so the next run shows what to add.
 */
#include "responder.h"
#include "agb.h"
#include <windows.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <time.h>

/* one fixed local identity (Hydra ids are 24 hex chars); never sent anywhere */
#define OFFLINE_ID "0ff11e000000000000000001"

static wchar_t dataPath[MAX_PATH];
static char sessionToken[64];
static int garrisonSize = 50;
int storePlaceholders = 1; /* ini StorePlaceholders; needed for the store (and the Garrison) to open */
static CRITICAL_SECTION notifLock; /* guards the pending Garrison notifications (see notif_add) */

void responder_init(const wchar_t *dataFile, int garrison)
{
    wcsncpy(dataPath, dataFile, MAX_PATH - 1);
    if (garrison > 0) garrisonSize = garrison;
    InitializeCriticalSection(&notifLock);
    /* a fresh local token per launch; it only has to be a non-empty string the client sends back to us */
    snprintf(sessionToken, sizeof sessionToken, "offline-%08lx%08lx", GetTickCount(), GetCurrentProcessId());
}

void resp_free(Response *r) { free(r->body); r->body = NULL; r->len = 0; }

/* ---------- local wallet: profiles/<id>/inventory ----------
 * After the 2018 Market shutdown the game moves the save's Mirian into the online wallet as "vc-earned"
 * (PUT {modifications:[{command:"set_count", slug:"vc-earned", count:N}]}) and zeroes PC_Mirian locally, then
 * reads the wallet back. A server that drops this loses the player's Mirian, so it's kept in OfflineWallet.txt
 * (one "slug=count" per line, next to the DLL). Only the game's own commands change it. */
typedef struct { char slug[64]; long long count; } WalletItem;
static WalletItem wallet[64];
static int walletN = -1;

static void wallet_path(wchar_t *out)
{
    wcsncpy(out, dataPath, MAX_PATH - 1); out[MAX_PATH - 1] = 0;
    wchar_t *s = wcsrchr(out, L'\\'); if (s) s[1] = 0;
    wcsncat(out, L"OfflineWallet.txt", MAX_PATH - wcslen(out) - 1);
}

static FILETIME walletStamp;
static void wallet_load(void)
{
    wchar_t path[MAX_PATH]; wallet_path(path);
    WIN32_FILE_ATTRIBUTE_DATA fa; FILETIME stamp = {0, 0};
    if (GetFileAttributesExW(path, GetFileExInfoStandard, &fa)) stamp = fa.ftLastWriteTime;
    if (walletN >= 0 && !CompareFileTime(&stamp, &walletStamp)) return; /* unchanged since last read */
    walletStamp = stamp;
    walletN = 0;
    FILE *f = _wfopen(path, L"r"); if (!f) return;
    char line[128];
    while (walletN < 64 && fgets(line, sizeof line, f)) {
        char *eq = strchr(line, '='); if (!eq || line[0] == '#') continue;
        *eq = 0; strncpy(wallet[walletN].slug, line, 63); wallet[walletN].count = _atoi64(eq + 1); walletN++;
    }
    fclose(f);
}

static void wallet_save(void)
{
    wchar_t path[MAX_PATH], tmp[MAX_PATH]; wallet_path(path);
    _snwprintf(tmp, MAX_PATH, L"%ls.tmp", path); tmp[MAX_PATH - 1] = 0;
    FILE *f = _wfopen(tmp, L"w"); if (!f) return;
    fprintf(f, "# Shadow of War Offline Mode: the online wallet, kept on this PC (vc-earned = Mirian moved online)\n");
    for (int i = 0; i < walletN; i++) fprintf(f, "%s=%lld\n", wallet[i].slug, wallet[i].count);
    fclose(f);
    MoveFileExW(tmp, path, MOVEFILE_REPLACE_EXISTING);
    WIN32_FILE_ATTRIBUTE_DATA fa; if (GetFileAttributesExW(path, GetFileExInfoStandard, &fa)) walletStamp = fa.ftLastWriteTime;
}

static WalletItem *wallet_get(const char *slug, int create)
{
    for (int i = 0; i < walletN; i++) if (!strcmp(wallet[i].slug, slug)) return &wallet[i];
    if (!create || walletN >= 64) return NULL;
    strncpy(wallet[walletN].slug, slug, 63); wallet[walletN].count = 0;
    return &wallet[walletN++];
}

static void wallet_apply(const unsigned char *req, size_t n)
{
    const unsigned char *mods; size_t mn;
    if (!req || !agb_map_find(req, n, "modifications", &mods, &mn)) { logw(L"    wallet: no modifications"); return; }
    int cnt = agb_array_len(mods, mn);
    for (int i = 0; i < cnt; i++) {
        const unsigned char *m, *v; size_t ml, vl; char cmd[32] = "", slug[64] = ""; long long c = 0;
        if (!agb_array_at(mods, mn, i, &m, &ml)) continue;
        if (agb_map_find(m, ml, "command", &v, &vl)) agb_as_str(v, vl, cmd, sizeof cmd);
        if (agb_map_find(m, ml, "slug", &v, &vl)) agb_as_str(v, vl, slug, sizeof slug);
        if (agb_map_find(m, ml, "count", &v, &vl)) agb_as_int(v, vl, &c);
        WalletItem *w = slug[0] ? wallet_get(slug, 1) : NULL;
        if (!w) { logw(L"    wallet: skipped %hs (no slug or full)", cmd); continue; }
        long long before = w->count;
        if (!strcmp(cmd, "set_count")) w->count = c;
        else if (strstr(cmd, "add") || strstr(cmd, "grant") || strstr(cmd, "incr")) w->count += c;
        else if (strstr(cmd, "remove") || strstr(cmd, "consume") || strstr(cmd, "decr") || strstr(cmd, "sub")) w->count -= c;
        else { logw(L"    wallet: UNKNOWN command '%hs' for %hs (count %lld) - not applied", cmd, slug, c); continue; }
        if (w->count < 0) w->count = 0;
        logw(L"    wallet: %hs %hs %lld -> %lld", cmd, slug, before, w->count);
    }
    wallet_save();
}

/* ---------- local object store: the Garrison ----------
 * Sending an orc to the Garrison is POST objects/user-garrison {data:{FactionMember:{...}, ...}} (~5 KB: gear,
 * appearance, traits). Each object is kept as one file OfflineGarrison\<id>.agb holding the encoded
 * {id, type, owner_id, created_at, updated_at, data} map, so the Garrison survives restarts and can be backed up. */
static void store_dir(wchar_t *out)
{
    wcsncpy(out, dataPath, MAX_PATH - 1); out[MAX_PATH - 1] = 0;
    wchar_t *s = wcsrchr(out, L'\\'); if (s) s[1] = 0;
    wcsncat(out, L"OfflineGarrison", MAX_PATH - wcslen(out) - 1);
}

static int valid_id(const char *id)
{
    size_t n = strlen(id);
    if (n < 8 || n > 40) return 0;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; i++) if (!((id[i] >= '0' && id[i] <= '9') || (id[i] >= 'a' && id[i] <= 'f'))) return 0;
    return 1;
}

static int obj_read(const char *id, unsigned char **buf, size_t *len)
{
    wchar_t dir[MAX_PATH], path[MAX_PATH]; store_dir(dir);
    if (!valid_id(id)) return 0;
    _snwprintf(path, MAX_PATH, L"%ls\\%hs.agb", dir, id); path[MAX_PATH - 1] = 0;
    FILE *f = _wfopen(path, L"rb"); if (!f) return 0;
    fseek(f, 0, SEEK_END); long n = ftell(f); fseek(f, 0, SEEK_SET);
    *buf = malloc(n > 0 ? n : 1); *len = fread(*buf, 1, n, f); fclose(f);
    return *len > 0;
}

static int obj_write(const char *id, const unsigned char *buf, size_t len)
{
    wchar_t dir[MAX_PATH], path[MAX_PATH], tmp[MAX_PATH]; store_dir(dir);
    if (!valid_id(id)) return 0;
    CreateDirectoryW(dir, NULL);
    _snwprintf(path, MAX_PATH, L"%ls\\%hs.agb", dir, id); path[MAX_PATH - 1] = 0;
    _snwprintf(tmp, MAX_PATH, L"%ls.tmp", path); tmp[MAX_PATH - 1] = 0;
    FILE *f = _wfopen(tmp, L"wb"); if (!f) return 0;
    size_t w = fwrite(buf, 1, len, f); fclose(f);
    return w == len && MoveFileExW(tmp, path, MOVEFILE_REPLACE_EXISTING);
}

/* encodes {id, type, owner_id, created_at, updated_at, data} with data copied verbatim */
static void obj_encode(Agb *b, const char *id, const char *type, uint32_t created, const unsigned char *data, size_t dlen)
{
    static const unsigned char emptyMap[] = { 0x60, 0x00 };
    if (!data || !dlen) { data = emptyMap; dlen = 2; }
    agb_map(b, 6);
    agb_kstr(b, "id", id);
    agb_kstr(b, "type", type);
    agb_kstr(b, "owner_id", OFFLINE_ID);
    agb_str(b, "created_at"); agb_date(b, created);
    agb_str(b, "updated_at"); agb_date(b, (uint32_t)time(NULL));
    agb_str(b, "data");
    Agb nd = { 0 };
    if (agb_normalize(data, dlen, &nd)) { agb_raw(b, nd.p, nd.n); agb_free(&nd); }
    else { agb_free(&nd); agb_raw(b, data, dlen); }
}

static void obj_field_str(const unsigned char *o, size_t n, const char *key, char *out, size_t cap)
{
    const unsigned char *v; size_t vl; out[0] = 0;
    if (agb_map_find(o, n, key, &v, &vl)) agb_as_str(v, vl, out, cap);
}

/* all stored objects of one type, as search results [{score, result}] */
static int obj_search(Agb *b, const char *type)
{
    wchar_t dir[MAX_PATH], pat[MAX_PATH]; store_dir(dir);
    _snwprintf(pat, MAX_PATH, L"%ls\\*.agb", dir); pat[MAX_PATH - 1] = 0;
    char ids[256][41]; int n = 0;
    WIN32_FIND_DATAW fd; HANDLE h = FindFirstFileW(pat, &fd);
    if (h != INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) {
        do {
            char id[64]; WideCharToMultiByte(CP_UTF8, 0, fd.cFileName, -1, id, sizeof id, NULL, NULL);
            char *dot = strrchr(id, '.'); if (dot) *dot = 0;
            unsigned char *o; size_t ol; char t[64];
            if (n < 256 && obj_read(id, &o, &ol)) {
                obj_field_str(o, ol, "type", t, sizeof t);
                if (!strcmp(t, type)) { strncpy(ids[n], id, 40); ids[n][40] = 0; n++; }
                free(o);
            }
        } while (FindNextFileW(h, &fd));
        FindClose(h);
    }
    agb_map(b, 5);
    agb_kstr(b, "cursor", "");
    agb_ki32(b, "start", 0);
    agb_ki32(b, "count", n);
    agb_ki32(b, "total", n);
    agb_str(b, "results"); agb_array(b, n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        unsigned char *o; size_t ol;
        agb_map(b, 2);
        agb_str(b, "score"); agb_f64(b, 1.0);
        agb_str(b, "result");
        if (obj_read(ids[i], &o, &ol)) { agb_raw(b, o, ol); free(o); } else agb_map(b, 0);
    }
    return n;
}

/* the wallet as the game reads it: [{slug, quantity, invdata}] (0x1417F66D8) plus hydra InventoryItem fields */
static void wallet_emit(Agb *b)
{
    int n = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < walletN; i++) if (wallet[i].count > 0) n++;
    agb_array(b, n);
    for (int i = 0; i < walletN; i++) {
        if (wallet[i].count <= 0) continue;
        long long c = wallet[i].count;
        agb_map(b, 8);
        agb_kstr(b, "id", wallet[i].slug);
        agb_kstr(b, "slug", wallet[i].slug);
        agb_kstr(b, "item_slug", wallet[i].slug);
        agb_str(b, "quantity"); agb_i64(b, c); /* Hydra reads counts only as int64 Values (0x140A01460): int32 reads as 0 */
        agb_str(b, "count"); agb_i64(b, c);
        agb_kstr(b, "account_id", OFFLINE_ID);
        agb_str(b, "invdata"); agb_map(b, 0);
        agb_str(b, "data"); agb_map(b, 0);
    }
}

/* ---------- notifications: accounts/me/notifications ----------
 * Deploying or destroying a Garrison orc runs a state machine (names at 0x141FE1DE8..0x141FE1EA8):
 * CreateGarrisonMemberRemoval (DELETE objects/user-garrison/<id>) -> WaitForGarrisonMemberRemoval ->
 * WaitForCurrent/NewNotifications -> AwardLoot (destroy, loot rolled locally from the orc) or the new captain
 * (deploy, rebuilt from the stored record) -> RemoveNotification. The server confirms the removal with a
 * notification {cmd:"garrison_removal", payload:{obj:<object id>}} (checks 0x141C508A0 / 0x141C509EC); without
 * it the flow fails and the orc is simply gone. GET .../unread must be a list (0x14098E0B0 wants Value type 5)
 * of hydra::Notification {id, cmd, header, payload, state, consumed} (fromValue 0x14529A910); a notification
 * without cmd is ignored. The game dismisses it with DELETE accounts/me/notifications/<id> (0x14098F5F0).
 * Kept in memory only: a confirmation is only useful while the game waits for it. */
static char notifObj[32][41]; /* object id per pending removal notification */
static int notifN;

static void notif_id(const char *obj, char *out) { snprintf(out, 25, "0ff11e0c%.16s", strlen(obj) > 8 ? obj + 8 : obj); }

static void notif_add(const char *obj)
{
    EnterCriticalSection(&notifLock);
    if (notifN == 32) { memmove(notifObj[0], notifObj[1], sizeof notifObj[0] * 31); notifN--; }
    strncpy(notifObj[notifN], obj, 40); notifObj[notifN][40] = 0; notifN++;
    LeaveCriticalSection(&notifLock);
}

/* drops every pending notification whose id appears in s (one id, or a bulk list in the query string) */
static int notif_remove_in(const char *s)
{
    int removed = 0;
    EnterCriticalSection(&notifLock);
    for (int i = 0; i < notifN; ) {
        char nid[25]; notif_id(notifObj[i], nid);
        if (strstr(s, nid)) { memmove(notifObj[i], notifObj[i + 1], sizeof notifObj[0] * (notifN - i - 1)); notifN--; removed++; }
        else i++;
    }
    LeaveCriticalSection(&notifLock);
    return removed;
}

static void notif_encode(Agb *b, const char *obj)
{
    char nid[25]; notif_id(obj, nid);
    /* the game's list (0x141868A74) keeps only {id, header, data} of each entry with consumed == false: the
     * removal checks compare header with "garrison_removal" and data.obj with the object id */
    agb_map(b, 9);
    agb_kstr(b, "id", nid);
    agb_kstr(b, "account_id", OFFLINE_ID);
    agb_kstr(b, "cmd", "garrison_removal");
    agb_kstr(b, "header", "garrison_removal");
    agb_kbool(b, "consumed", 0);
    agb_str(b, "payload"); agb_map(b, 1); agb_kstr(b, "obj", obj);
    agb_str(b, "created_at"); agb_date(b, (uint32_t)time(NULL));
    agb_str(b, "data"); agb_map(b, 1); agb_kstr(b, "obj", obj);
    agb_str(b, "server_data"); agb_map(b, 0);
}

static void notif_emit(Agb *b, const char *onlyId)
{
    EnterCriticalSection(&notifLock);
    int n = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < notifN; i++) { char nid[25]; notif_id(notifObj[i], nid); if (!onlyId || !strcmp(nid, onlyId)) n++; }
    if (!onlyId) agb_array(b, n);
    for (int i = 0; i < notifN; i++) {
        char nid[25]; notif_id(notifObj[i], nid);
        if (!onlyId || !strcmp(nid, onlyId)) { notif_encode(b, notifObj[i]); if (onlyId) break; }
    }
    if (onlyId && !n) agb_map(b, 0);
    LeaveCriticalSection(&notifLock);
}

static void finish(Response *out, int status, Agb *b)
{
    out->status = status; out->body = b->p; out->len = b->n;
}

/* path without leading slashes or query string, e.g. "auth", "ssc/invoke/garrison-get-collection" */
static void norm_path(const wchar_t *path, char *out, size_t cap)
{
    while (*path == L'/') path++;
    size_t i = 0;
    for (; *path && *path != L'?' && i + 1 < cap; path++) out[i++] = (char)(*path < 128 ? *path : '?');
    out[i] = 0;
}

void respond(const wchar_t *verb, const wchar_t *path, const unsigned char *req, size_t reqLen, Response *out)
{
    char p[512];
    Agb b = { 0 };
    norm_path(path, p, sizeof p);


    if (!strcmp(p, "auth")) {
        agb_map(&b, 2);
        agb_kstr(&b, "token", sessionToken);
        agb_kstr(&b, "type", "steam");
        return finish(out, 200, &b);
    }
    if (!strcmp(p, "access")) {
        /* The game counts itself signed in only when both "account" and "profile" are maps and profile.data
         * is a map (0x141B5229C / 0x141B526AC). account.wbplay_identity.email and account.opt_ins.wbplay_optin
         * are read (0x141B52760); profile.server_data.telemetry_settings.send_sampled_events is read (0x141B526DC). */
        agb_map(&b, 3);
        agb_kstr(&b, "token", sessionToken);
        agb_str(&b, "account");
        agb_map(&b, 5);
        agb_kstr(&b, "id", OFFLINE_ID);
        agb_kstr(&b, "public_id", OFFLINE_ID);
        agb_kstr(&b, "username", "Offline");
        /* a non-empty email makes the game treat WB Play as registered (copied to +0x23EC by 0x141B52760); .invalid never resolves */
        agb_str(&b, "wbplay_identity"); agb_map(&b, 2); agb_kstr(&b, "email", "offline@offline.invalid"); agb_kstr(&b, "username", "Offline");
        agb_str(&b, "opt_ins"); agb_map(&b, 1); agb_kbool(&b, "wbplay_optin", 0);
        agb_str(&b, "profile");
        agb_map(&b, 4);
        agb_kstr(&b, "id", OFFLINE_ID);
        agb_kstr(&b, "account_id", OFFLINE_ID);
        agb_str(&b, "data"); agb_map(&b, 0);
        agb_str(&b, "server_data"); agb_map(&b, 1);
        agb_str(&b, "telemetry_settings"); agb_map(&b, 1); agb_kbool(&b, "send_sampled_events", 0);
        return finish(out, 200, &b);
    }
    if (!strcmp(p, "ssc/invoke/get_server_time")) {
        /* 0x141B5238C: clock offset = server_time + (now - query_start_MS) / 2, both read as ints */
        long long startMs = 0;
        const wchar_t *q = wcsstr(path, L"query_start_MS=");
        if (q) startMs = _wtoi64(q + 15);
        FILETIME ft; GetSystemTimeAsFileTime(&ft);
        long long nowMs = (long long)((((unsigned long long)ft.dwHighDateTime << 32) | ft.dwLowDateTime) / 10000ULL) - 11644473600000LL;
        agb_map(&b, 2);
        agb_str(&b, "server_time"); agb_i64(&b, nowMs);
        agb_str(&b, "query_start_MS"); agb_i64(&b, startMs);
        return finish(out, 200, &b);
    }

    if (!strncmp(p, "profiles/", 9) && strlen(p) > 10 && !strcmp(p + strlen(p) - 10, "/inventory")) {
        wallet_load();
        if (!wcscmp(verb, L"PUT") || !wcscmp(verb, L"POST")) wallet_apply(req, reqLen);
        wallet_emit(&b);
        return finish(out, 200, &b);
    }

    if (!strcmp(p, "ssc/invoke/valve_userinfo")) {
        /* The Store (which hosts the Garrison screen) waits for this before loading (0x1417F7894 reads
         * status.currency and status.country). Only labels prices; the local catalog stays empty. */
        agb_map(&b, 1);
        agb_str(&b, "status");
        agb_map(&b, 2);
        agb_kstr(&b, "currency", "USD");
        agb_kstr(&b, "country", "US");
        return finish(out, 200, &b);
    }

    if (!strncmp(p, "broadcast_channels/", 19) && strstr(p, "/broadcasts/timeline")) {
        /* Same cursor container as searches (0x1409886A0); each result is a message
         * {broadcast_channel_slug, content, start_at, end_at} (0x14510D970).
         * "game-settings" is WB's remote config, read by CloudServicesGameSettingsMgr (0x1418368B0):
         * store_enabled = false is what shows "We have temporarily disabled the Garrison"
         * (UI_MenuError_Store_Closed_Body). Every other channel (MOTD, store ticker...) stays empty. */
        char slug[64] = "";
        sscanf(p + 19, "%63[^/]", slug);
        if (!strcmp(slug, "game-settings")) {
            char json[256];
            snprintf(json, sizeof json,
                "{\"store_enabled\":true,\"garrison_size\":%d,\"vendettas_enabled\":false,\"telemetry_enabled\":false}",
                garrisonSize);
            uint32_t now = (uint32_t)time(NULL);
            agb_map(&b, 5);
            agb_kstr(&b, "cursor", "");
            agb_ki32(&b, "start", 0);
            agb_ki32(&b, "count", 1);
            agb_ki32(&b, "total", 1);
            agb_str(&b, "results"); agb_array(&b, 1);
            /* the game reads message, slug, message_id, start_at, end_at and the settings MAP under "data"
             * (0x1417B5C04 -> 0x1417B548C copies data to +0x3290, parsed by 0x1418368B0) */
            agb_map(&b, 8);
            agb_kstr(&b, "broadcast_channel_slug", "game-settings");
            agb_kstr(&b, "slug", "game-settings");
            agb_kstr(&b, "message_id", "offline-game-settings");
            agb_kstr(&b, "message", "");
            agb_kstr(&b, "content", json);
            agb_str(&b, "start_at"); agb_date(&b, now - 86400);
            agb_str(&b, "end_at"); agb_date(&b, now + 3650u * 86400u);
            agb_str(&b, "data");
            agb_map(&b, 4);
            agb_kbool(&b, "store_enabled", 1);
            agb_ki32(&b, "garrison_size", garrisonSize);
            agb_kbool(&b, "vendettas_enabled", 0);
            agb_kbool(&b, "telemetry_enabled", 0);
            return finish(out, 200, &b);
        }
        if (!strcmp(slug, "store-front") || !strcmp(slug, "japan-store-front")) {
            /* The store (and the Garrison inside it) is "inaccessible" until a storefront layout exists
             * (commerce+0x268, built by 0x1418633BC from this channel's message data). Needs version 2 and
             * non-empty act_i/act_ii rack ids. racks = [] means an empty storefront: no products at all. */
            uint32_t now = (uint32_t)time(NULL);
            agb_map(&b, 5);
            agb_kstr(&b, "cursor", "");
            agb_ki32(&b, "start", 0);
            agb_ki32(&b, "count", 1);
            agb_ki32(&b, "total", 1);
            agb_str(&b, "results"); agb_array(&b, 1);
            agb_map(&b, 7);
            agb_kstr(&b, "broadcast_channel_slug", slug);
            agb_kstr(&b, "slug", slug);
            agb_kstr(&b, "message_id", "offline-store-front");
            agb_kstr(&b, "message", "");
            agb_str(&b, "start_at"); agb_date(&b, now - 86400);
            agb_str(&b, "end_at"); agb_date(&b, now + 3650u * 86400u);
            agb_str(&b, "data");
            agb_map(&b, 5);
            agb_ki32(&b, "version", 2);
            agb_str(&b, "title"); agb_map(&b, 1); agb_kstr(&b, "enUS", "Garrison");
            agb_kstr(&b, "act_i", "offline");
            agb_kstr(&b, "act_ii", "offline");
            agb_str(&b, "racks"); agb_array(&b, 0);
            return finish(out, 200, &b);
        }
        agb_map(&b, 5);
        agb_kstr(&b, "cursor", "");
        agb_ki32(&b, "start", 0);
        agb_ki32(&b, "count", 0);
        agb_ki32(&b, "total", 0);
        agb_str(&b, "results"); agb_array(&b, 0);
        return finish(out, 200, &b);
    }

    /* The store (which hosts the Garrison) only counts as accessible when the item-definition list and the
     * product catalog are both non-empty (0x14071D900 / 0x1417F5D58 test commerce+0x238 / +0x220). Both
     * endpoints must return an array (0x140992F00 / 0x140998F90). Each gets ONE inert placeholder: max_count 0,
     * no price, no grants, not on any storefront shelf. Nothing can be bought, granted or used. */
    if (storePlaceholders && !strcmp(p, "inventory/items")) {
        /* hydra::InventoryItem (fromValue 0x14512EBC0, vtable 0x141E28868): count (int), item_slug, account_id.
         * The first build sent definition-style fields without count and crashed at +0xA00360. */
        agb_array(&b, 1);
        agb_map(&b, 6);
        agb_kstr(&b, "id", "offline-placeholder");
        agb_ki32(&b, "count", 0);
        agb_kstr(&b, "item_slug", "offline-placeholder");
        agb_kstr(&b, "account_id", OFFLINE_ID);
        agb_kstr(&b, "slug", "offline-placeholder");
        agb_str(&b, "data"); agb_map(&b, 0);
        return finish(out, 200, &b);
    }
    if (storePlaceholders && !strcmp(p, "commerce/catalog/me/products")) {
        /* hydra::CatalogProduct (fromValue 0x14099EE30, vtable 0x141E2A6A8): name, description (strings),
         * tags (array), payment_options (map, parsed unchecked), items (array of {item, quantity}). */
        agb_array(&b, 1);
        agb_map(&b, 10);
        agb_kstr(&b, "id", "offline-placeholder");
        agb_kstr(&b, "slug", "offline-placeholder");
        agb_kstr(&b, "name", "Offline");
        agb_kstr(&b, "description", "");
        agb_str(&b, "tags"); agb_array(&b, 0);
        agb_str(&b, "payment_options"); agb_map(&b, 0);
        agb_str(&b, "items"); agb_array(&b, 0);
        agb_str(&b, "applied_sales"); agb_array(&b, 0);
        agb_str(&b, "data"); agb_map(&b, 0);
        agb_str(&b, "proddata");
        agb_map(&b, 10);
        agb_str(&b, "name"); agb_map(&b, 0);
        agb_str(&b, "description"); agb_map(&b, 0);
        agb_str(&b, "details"); agb_map(&b, 0);
        agb_kstr(&b, "icon_id", "");
        agb_kstr(&b, "image_id", "");
        agb_ki32(&b, "unpack_uruks", 0);
        agb_ki32(&b, "unpack_inventory", 0);
        agb_ki32(&b, "grant_total", 0);
        agb_kbool(&b, "limited_quantity", 0);
        agb_ki32(&b, "max_count", 0);
        return finish(out, 200, &b);
    }

    if (!strncmp(p, "objects/types/", 14) && strstr(p, "/search_queries/") && strstr(p, "/run")) {
        /* cursor-paged search (parser 0x14097A090): {cursor, start, count, total, results: [{score, result}]}.
         * The Garrison is "objects/types/user-garrison/search_queries/garrison-get-collection/run". */
        char type[64] = "";
        sscanf(p + 14, "%63[^/]", type);
        int n = obj_search(&b, type);
        logw(L"    garrison: %d stored %hs object(s)", n, type);
        return finish(out, 200, &b);
    }

    if (!strncmp(p, "objects/", 8)) {
        /* Hydra objects. POST objects/<type> creates; GET/PUT/DELETE objects/<id>. Replies always carry an id and
         * a data map: the object reader 0x14097D7F0 iterates data without a null check. */
        /* paths seen: POST objects/user-garrison, GET objects/user-garrison/<id>; also accept objects/<id> */
        const char *rest = p + 8;
        char seg[64] = "", seg2[64] = "";
        sscanf(rest, "%63[^/]/%63[^/?]", seg, seg2);
        if (seg2[0] && valid_id(seg2)) strcpy(seg, seg2);
        int isPost = !wcscmp(verb, L"POST"), isPut = !wcscmp(verb, L"PUT"), isDel = !wcscmp(verb, L"DELETE");
        const unsigned char *data = NULL; size_t dlen = 0;
        if (req && reqLen) agb_map_find(req, reqLen, "data", &data, &dlen);
        if (isPost && !valid_id(seg)) {
            static unsigned serial;
            char oid[32];
            snprintf(oid, sizeof oid, "0ff11e0b%08x%08x", (unsigned)time(NULL), ++serial);
            obj_encode(&b, oid, seg, (uint32_t)time(NULL), data, dlen);
            int ok = obj_write(oid, b.p, b.n);
            logw(L"    garrison: created %hs object %hs (%zu bytes of data) %ls", seg, oid, dlen, ok ? L"saved" : L"SAVE FAILED");
            return finish(out, 200, &b);
        }
        unsigned char *o = NULL; size_t ol = 0;
        int have = obj_read(seg, &o, &ol);
        if (isDel) {
            wchar_t dir[MAX_PATH], path[MAX_PATH] = L""; store_dir(dir);
            BOOL gone = FALSE; DWORD err = 0;
            if (valid_id(seg)) { _snwprintf(path, MAX_PATH, L"%ls\\%hs.agb", dir, seg); path[MAX_PATH - 1] = 0; gone = DeleteFileW(path); if (!gone) err = GetLastError(); }
            if (gone) logw(L"    garrison: deleted object %hs", seg);
            else logw(L"    garrison: delete of %hs failed (%ls, error %lu)", seg, have ? L"existed" : L"not found", err);
            /* confirm the removal so Deploy / Destroy for gear can finish (see notif_add) */
            if (have) { notif_add(seg); logw(L"    garrison: queued garrison_removal notification for %hs", seg); }
            /* reply with the removed object: an empty {} made "Destroy for gear" show a data error and grant no gear */
            if (have) { agb_raw(&b, o, ol); free(o); return finish(out, 200, &b); }
            agb_map(&b, 3);
            agb_kstr(&b, "id", seg);
            agb_kstr(&b, "owner_id", OFFLINE_ID);
            agb_str(&b, "data"); agb_map(&b, 0);
            return finish(out, 200, &b);
        }
        if (isPut && have && data) {
            char type[64]; obj_field_str(o, ol, "type", type, sizeof type);
            obj_encode(&b, seg, type, (uint32_t)time(NULL), data, dlen);
            obj_write(seg, b.p, b.n);
            logw(L"    garrison: replaced data of %hs", seg);
            free(o);
            return finish(out, 200, &b);
        }
        if (isPut) logw(L"    garrison: PUT on %hs not applied (%ls) - shape logged above", seg, have ? L"no data field" : L"unknown object");
        if (have) { agb_raw(&b, o, ol); free(o); return finish(out, 200, &b); }
        logw(L"    garrison: %ls %hs - no such object", verb, seg);
        agb_map(&b, 3);
        agb_kstr(&b, "id", valid_id(seg) ? seg : "0ff11e0b0000000000000000");
        agb_kstr(&b, "owner_id", OFFLINE_ID);
        agb_str(&b, "data"); agb_map(&b, 0);
        return finish(out, 200, &b);
    }

    if (!strncmp(p, "accounts/me/notifications", 25)) {
        const char *rest = p[25] == '/' ? p + 26 : "";
        if (!strcmp(rest, "unread") || !rest[0]) {
            notif_emit(&b, NULL);
            EnterCriticalSection(&notifLock); int n = notifN; LeaveCriticalSection(&notifLock);
            if (n) logw(L"    notifications: served %d pending", n);
            return finish(out, 200, &b);
        }
        if (!wcscmp(verb, L"DELETE") || !wcscmp(verb, L"PUT") || !wcscmp(verb, L"POST")) {
            /* dismiss one (notifications/<id>) or several (notifications/bulk/?...): match ids anywhere in the
             * full path including the query string, and in the body as text */
            char full[1024]; size_t i = 0;
            for (const wchar_t *w = path; *w && i + 1 < sizeof full; w++) full[i++] = (char)(*w < 128 ? *w : '?');
            full[i] = 0;
            int n = notif_remove_in(full);
            if (req && reqLen) {
                char *txt = malloc(reqLen * 4 + 64);
                if (txt) { agb_to_text(req, reqLen, txt, reqLen * 4 + 64); n += notif_remove_in(txt); free(txt); }
            }
            logw(L"    notifications: %ls dismissed %d", verb, n);
            agb_map(&b, 0);
            return finish(out, 200, &b);
        }
        notif_emit(&b, rest); /* GET notifications/<id> */
        return finish(out, 200, &b);
    }

    /* not modelled yet: an empty map, logged by the caller */
    agb_map(&b, 0);
    finish(out, 200, &b);
}
```

```h
#pragma once
#include <stddef.h>
#include <wchar.h>

typedef struct { int status; unsigned char *body; size_t len; } Response;

void responder_init(const wchar_t *dataFile, int garrisonSize);
/* Builds the local answer to one Hydra request. Never touches the network. */
void respond(const wchar_t *verb, const wchar_t *path, const unsigned char *req, size_t reqLen, Response *out);
void resp_free(Response *r);
void logw(const wchar_t *fmt, ...);
```

`examples/shadow-of-war-offline-mode/tools/log_to_object.py`:

```py
"""Rebuild a stored Garrison object (OfflineGarrison/<id>.agb) from a request decoded in OfflineMode.log.

Usage: python log_to_object.py <OfflineMode.log> <object id> <out dir> [type]
Takes the last 'POST objects/<type>' request in the log, re-encodes its JSON-like text as x-ag-binary the way
the stand-in stores objects (every integer int64, every float f64) and writes {id,type,owner_id,created_at,updated_at,data}.
"""
import json, re, struct, sys, time, os

OFFLINE_ID = "0ff11e000000000000000001"

def sized(base, n):
    if n <= 0xFF: return bytes([base, n])
    if n <= 0xFFFF: return bytes([base + 1]) + struct.pack(">H", n)
    return bytes([base + 2]) + struct.pack(">I", n)

def enc(v):
    if isinstance(v, bool): return b"\x02" if v else b"\x03"
    if isinstance(v, int): return b"\x16" + struct.pack(">q", v)
    if isinstance(v, float): return b"\x21" + struct.pack(">d", v)
    if isinstance(v, str):
        if re.fullmatch(r"@\d+", v): return b"\x40" + struct.pack(">I", int(v[1:]))
        # the log prints raw string bytes through the ANSI code page (cp1252), so map back to the original bytes
        try: b = v.encode("cp1252")
        except UnicodeEncodeError: b = v.encode("utf-8")
        return sized(0x30, len(b)) + b
    if isinstance(v, list): return sized(0x50, len(v)) + b"".join(enc(x) for x in v)
    if isinstance(v, dict): return sized(0x60, len(v)) + b"".join(enc(k) + enc(x) for k, x in v.items())
    raise ValueError(f"cannot encode {type(v)}")

def main():
    log, oid, outdir = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2], sys.argv[3]
    otype = sys.argv[4] if len(sys.argv) > 4 else "user-garrison"
    lines = open(log, encoding="utf-8-sig", errors="replace").read().splitlines()
    body = None
    for i, ln in enumerate(lines):
        if re.search(rf" POST objects/{re.escape(otype)}\s", ln):
            m = re.search(r"request \(\d+ bytes\): (.*)$", lines[i + 1]) if i + 1 < len(lines) else None
            if m: body = m.group(1)
    if body is None: sys.exit("no POST objects/%s request found" % otype)
    # dates are logged as @123 (bare) - quote them so json can parse; '<n bytes>' blobs can't be recovered
    if re.search(r"<\d+ bytes>|<type 0x", body): sys.exit("request contains binary blobs or unknown types; cannot rebuild")
    body = re.sub(r'(?<=[:\[,])@(\d+)', r'"@\1"', body)
    req = json.loads(body, object_pairs_hook=dict)
    now = int(time.time())
    obj = {"id": oid, "type": otype, "owner_id": OFFLINE_ID, "created_at": f"@{now}", "updated_at": f"@{now}", "data": req["data"]}
    os.makedirs(outdir, exist_ok=True)
    path = os.path.join(outdir, oid + ".agb")
    open(path, "wb").write(enc(obj))
    print(f"wrote {path} ({os.path.getsize(path)} bytes); data keys: {list(req['data'].keys())}")

main()

```

```ps1
# Removes Shadow of War Offline Mode. Keeps your Garrison (OfflineGarrison\) and wallet (OfflineWallet.txt).
param([string]$Game = "C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\ShadowOfWar")
$x64 = Join-Path $Game "x64"
if (Get-Process ShadowOfWar -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { throw "Close Shadow of War first." }
Remove-Item "$x64\winhttp.dll", "$x64\OfflineMode.ini" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
```

`examples/terraria-tmodloader/FalArsenal/Boss.cs`:

```cs
using System;
using Microsoft.Xna.Framework;
using Microsoft.Xna.Framework.Graphics;
using Terraria;
using Terraria.Audio;
using Terraria.GameContent;
using Terraria.GameContent.ItemDropRules;
using Terraria.ID;
using Terraria.ModLoader;

namespace FalArsenal
{
	/// <summary>
	/// A boss that isn't in Terraria. Phase 1: circles high above the player, launches Scrap Drones
	/// and fires laser fans. Below half health it turns red: faster, dashes, and fires homing rockets.
	/// Vanilla boss plumbing: health bar, boss music, "has awoken!/has been defeated!" messages, loot.
	/// Summoned with /mothership.
	/// </summary>
	public class DroneMothership : ModNPC
	{
		public override string Texture => "FalArsenal/Assets/DroneMothership";
		bool Phase2 => NPC.life < NPC.lifeMax / 2;

		public override void SetStaticDefaults()
		{
			Main.npcFrameCount[Type] = 2;
			NPCID.Sets.MPAllowedEnemies[Type] = true; // lets a multiplayer client ask the server to summon it
		}

		public override void SetDefaults()
		{
			NPC.width = 200; NPC.height = 90;
			NPC.lifeMax = 5200; NPC.damage = 28; NPC.defense = 8;
			NPC.boss = true; NPC.noGravity = true; NPC.noTileCollide = true; NPC.lavaImmune = true;
			NPC.knockBackResist = 0f; NPC.npcSlots = 10f;
			NPC.HitSound = SoundID.NPCHit4; NPC.DeathSound = SoundID.NPCDeath14;
			NPC.aiStyle = -1; NPC.value = Item.buyPrice(gold: 8);
			Music = MusicID.Boss2;
		}

		public override void AI()
		{
			NPC.TargetClosest();
			var p = Main.player[NPC.target];
			if (p.dead || !p.active) // nobody left to chase: fly off and despawn, like vanilla bosses
			{
				NPC.velocity.Y -= 0.1f;
				NPC.EncourageDespawn(10);
				return;
			}
			ref float t = ref NPC.ai[0];
			ref float dash = ref NPC.ai[1];
			t++;
			bool p2 = Phase2;
			if (dash > 0)
			{
				dash--;
				NPC.velocity *= 0.985f;
			}
			else
			{
				var hover = p.Center + new Vector2(MathF.Sin(t * 0.012f) * 250, -225 + MathF.Sin(t * 0.031f) * 30); // stays on screen
				NPC.velocity += (hover - NPC.Center).SafeNormalize(Vector2.Zero) * (p2 ? 0.3f : 0.18f);
				float max = p2 ? 9f : 6f;
				if (NPC.velocity.Length() > max) NPC.velocity = Vector2.Normalize(NPC.velocity) * max;
				NPC.velocity *= 0.985f;
				if (p2 && t % 260 == 0)
				{
					NPC.velocity = (p.Center - NPC.Center).SafeNormalize(Vector2.UnitY) * 15f;
					dash = 45;
					SoundEngine.PlaySound(SoundID.Roar with { Pitch = 0.4f }, NPC.Center);
				}
			}
			// caught in an orbital beam: held in place (and it can't dash out)
			foreach (var pr in Main.ActiveProjectiles)
				if (pr.ModProjectile is OrbitalBeam beam && beam.Firing && Math.Abs(pr.Center.X - NPC.Center.X) < 120)
				{
					NPC.velocity *= 0.8f;
					dash = 0;
				}
			// never sink into the ground (it ignores tiles)
			float ground = Fx.SurfaceTile((int)(NPC.Center.X / 16)) * 16f;
			if (NPC.Bottom.Y > ground - 80) NPC.velocity.Y = Math.Min(NPC.velocity.Y, -3f);
			NPC.rotation = NPC.velocity.X * 0.015f;
			var core = NPC.Center + new Vector2(0, 26);
			if (Main.netMode != NetmodeID.MultiplayerClient)
			{
				if (t % (p2 ? 55 : 85) == 30) // laser fan from the core
				{
					var baseDir = (p.Center - core).SafeNormalize(Vector2.UnitY);
					for (int k = -2; k <= 2; k++)
						Projectile.NewProjectile(NPC.GetSource_FromAI(), core, baseDir.RotatedBy(k * 0.22f) * 7.5f, ProjectileID.PinkLaser, 10, 0f);
					SoundEngine.PlaySound(SoundID.Item33, core);
				}
				if (!p2 && t % 150 == 75 && NPC.CountNPCS(ModContent.NPCType<ScrapDrone>()) < 5) // launch drones
					for (int s = -1; s <= 1; s += 2)
					{
						NPC.NewNPC(NPC.GetSource_FromAI(), (int)(NPC.Center.X + s * 80), (int)NPC.Bottom.Y, ModContent.NPCType<ScrapDrone>());
						SoundEngine.PlaySound(SoundID.Item149, NPC.Center);
					}
				if (p2 && t % 70 == 20) // homing rockets out of both wings
					for (int s = -1; s <= 1; s += 2)
						Projectile.NewProjectile(NPC.GetSource_FromAI(), NPC.Center + new Vector2(s * 90, 0), new Vector2(s * 5, -3), ModContent.ProjectileType<HostileRocket>(), 12, 0f);
			}
			Lighting.AddLight(core, p2 ? 1.2f : 0.9f, 0.15f, 0.1f);
			if (p2 && Main.rand.NextBool(3))
				Dust.NewDustPerfect(NPC.Center + Main.rand.NextVector2Circular(90, 30), DustID.Smoke, new Vector2(0, -1), 120, default, 1.6f).noGravity = true;
		}

		// frame 2 is the same hull with the red core flared: blinks faster in phase 2
		public override void FindFrame(int frameHeight) => NPC.frame.Y = (int)(NPC.ai[0] / (Phase2 ? 5 : 10) % 2) * frameHeight;

		public override Color? GetAlpha(Color drawColor) => Phase2 ? Color.Lerp(drawColor, new Color(255, 90, 80), 0.35f) : null;

		public override void HitEffect(NPC.HitInfo hit)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++)
				Dust.NewDustPerfect(NPC.Center + Main.rand.NextVector2Circular(90, 35), DustID.Electric, Main.rand.NextVector2Circular(4, 4), 0, default, 1f).noGravity = true;
			if (NPC.life <= 0)
				Fx.BigBoom(NPC.Center);
		}

		public override void BossLoot(ref int potionType) => potionType = ItemID.HealingPotion;

		public override void ModifyNPCLoot(NPCLoot loot)
		{
			loot.Add(ItemDropRule.Common(ItemID.GoldCoin, 1, 6, 9));
			loot.Add(ItemDropRule.Common(ItemID.SoulofFlight, 1, 8, 14));
			loot.Add(ItemDropRule.Common(ItemID.HallowedBar, 1, 10, 18));
		}
	}

	/// <summary>The Mothership's phase-2 rocket: steers toward the nearest player.</summary>
	public class HostileRocket : ModProjectile
	{
		public override string Texture => "FalArsenal/Assets/HomingMissile";

		public override void SetDefaults()
		{
			Projectile.width = Projectile.height = 14;
			Projectile.hostile = true; Projectile.friendly = false;
			Projectile.tileCollide = false; Projectile.timeLeft = 240;
		}

		public override void AI()
		{
			var p = Main.player[Player.FindClosest(Projectile.position, Projectile.width, Projectile.height)];
			var dir = Projectile.velocity.SafeNormalize(Vector2.UnitX);
			if (Projectile.ai[0]++ > 15)
				dir = Vector2.Normalize(dir * 20f + (p.Center - Projectile.Center).SafeNormalize(dir));
			Projectile.velocity = dir * Math.Min(Projectile.velocity.Length() + 0.15f, 8.5f);
			Projectile.rotation = Projectile.velocity.ToRotation();
			Dust.NewDustPerfect(Projectile.Center - dir * 14, DustID.Torch, -dir * 2, 0, default, 1.5f).noGravity = true;
			Dust.NewDustPerfect(Projectile.Center - dir * 14, DustID.Smoke, Vector2.Zero, 120, default, 1.2f).noGravity = true;
		}

		public override bool PreDraw(ref Color lightColor)
		{
			var tex = TextureAssets.Projectile[Type].Value;
			Main.EntitySpriteDraw(tex, Projectile.Center - Main.screenPosition, null, new Color(255, 120, 110), Projectile.rotation, tex.Size() / 2, 1.1f, SpriteEffects.None);
			return false;
		}

		public override void OnKill(int timeLeft)
		{
			SoundEngine.PlaySound(SoundID.Item14 with { Volume = 0.6f }, Projectile.Center);
			Fx.SmallBoom(Projectile.Center, 1.1f);
		}
	}
}
```

`examples/terraria-tmodloader/FalArsenal/Commands.cs`:

```cs
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Microsoft.Xna.Framework;
using Terraria;
using Terraria.Audio;
using Terraria.DataStructures;
using Terraria.ID;
using Terraria.ModLoader;

namespace FalArsenal
{
	// Chat commands (type them in chat, like /help). CommandType.Chat runs on the typing player's own
	// machine, in single player and on a multiplayer client.

	/// <summary>/arsenal: one of every item this mod adds.</summary>
	public class ArsenalCommand : ModCommand
	{
		public override CommandType Type => CommandType.Chat;
		public override string Command => "arsenal";
		public override string Description => "Gives you every Fal Arsenal weapon";

		public override void Action(CommandCaller caller, string input, string[] args)
		{
			var source = new EntitySource_DebugCommand("/" + Command);
			var names = new List<string>();
			foreach (var item in Mod.GetContent<ModItem>())
			{
				caller.Player.QuickSpawnItem(source, item.Type); // dropped on the player, picked up at once (synced in multiplayer)
				names.Add(item.DisplayName.Value);
			}
			caller.Reply("Fal Arsenal: " + string.Join(", ", names), new Color(255, 170, 60));
		}
	}

	/// <summary>/mothership: summons the Drone Mothership near you.</summary>
	public class MothershipCommand : ModCommand
	{
		public override CommandType Type => CommandType.Chat;
		public override string Command => "mothership";
		public override string Description => "Summons the Drone Mothership boss";

		public override void Action(CommandCaller caller, string input, string[] args)
		{
			var player = caller.Player;
			int type = ModContent.NPCType<DroneMothership>();
			if (NPC.AnyNPCs(type))
			{
				caller.Reply("The Drone Mothership is already here.", new Color(255, 170, 60));
				return;
			}
			SoundEngine.PlaySound(SoundID.Roar, player.position);
			// the vanilla boss-summon path: SpawnOnPlayer places it just off-screen and announces it;
			// a multiplayer client asks the server instead (allowed by NPCID.Sets.MPAllowedEnemies)
			if (Main.netMode != NetmodeID.MultiplayerClient)
				NPC.SpawnOnPlayer(player.whoAmI, type);
			else
				NetMessage.SendData(MessageID.SpawnBossUseLicenseStartEvent, number: player.whoAmI, number2: type);
		}
	}
}

```

`examples/terraria-tmodloader/FalArsenal/EnergyWeapons.cs`:

```cs
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Microsoft.Xna.Framework;
using Microsoft.Xna.Framework.Graphics;
using Terraria;
using Terraria.Audio;
using Terraria.DataStructures;
using Terraria.Graphics.CameraModifiers;
using Terraria.ID;
using Terraria.ModLoader;

namespace FalArsenal
{
	// ------------------------------------------------------------------ Tesla Rifle: chain lightning

	public class TeslaRifle : ModItem
	{
		public override string Texture => "FalArsenal/Assets/TeslaRifle";

		public override void SetDefaults()
		{
			Item.width = 62; Item.height = 30;
			Item.useStyle = ItemUseStyleID.Shoot; Item.useTime = Item.useAnimation = 13; Item.autoReuse = true;
			Item.damage = 40; Item.DamageType = DamageClass.Magic; Item.knockBack = 2f; Item.noMelee = true;
			Item.shoot = ModContent.ProjectileType<TeslaArc>(); Item.shootSpeed = 1f;
			Item.UseSound = SoundID.Item93; Item.rare = ItemRarityID.Cyan;
		}

		public override Vector2? HoldoutOffset() => new Vector2(-8, 0);

		public override bool Shoot(Player player, EntitySource_ItemUse_WithAmmo source, Vector2 position, Vector2 velocity, int type, int damage, float knockback)
		{
			// first target: nearest enemy within 30 degrees of the aim, then hop to up to 4 more
			var aim = velocity.SafeNormalize(Vector2.UnitX);
			var muzzle = player.Center + aim * 34;
			var hit = new HashSet<int>();
			var first = Fx.Nearest(muzzle, 800, n => Vector2.Dot((n.Center - muzzle).SafeNormalize(aim), aim) > 0.86f);
			var from = muzzle;
			if (first == null)
			{
				Projectile.NewProjectile(source, from, Vector2.Zero, type, 0, 0, player.whoAmI, aim.X * 420, aim.Y * 420);
				return false;
			}
			var cur = first;
			float dmg = damage;
			for (int k = 0; k < 5 && cur != null; k++)
			{
				var span = cur.Center - from;
				Projectile.NewProjectile(source, from, Vector2.Zero, type, 0, 0, player.whoAmI, span.X, span.Y);
				if (player.whoAmI == Main.myPlayer) cur.SimpleStrikeNPC((int)dmg, Math.Sign(cur.Center.X - from.X), Main.rand.NextBool(8), 2f, DamageClass.Magic);
				for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++)
					Dust.NewDustPerfect(cur.Center + Main.rand.NextVector2Circular(12, 12), DustID.Electric, Main.rand.NextVector2Circular(4, 4), 0, default, 1.1f).noGravity = true;
				hit.Add(cur.whoAmI);
				from = cur.Center;
				dmg *= 0.85f;
				cur = Fx.Nearest(from, 340, n => !hit.Contains(n.whoAmI));
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override void AddRecipes() => CreateRecipe()
			.AddRecipeGroup(RecipeGroupID.IronBar, 8)
			.AddIngredient(ItemID.FallenStar, 3)
			.AddTile(TileID.Anvils)
			.Register();
	}

	/// <summary>Visual only: a flickering jagged arc from its spawn point to spawn point + (ai[0], ai[1]).
	/// The span rides in ai (not velocity) because ai is what gets synced to other players.</summary>
	public class TeslaArc : ModProjectile
	{
		public override string Texture => "FalArsenal/Assets/HomingMissile"; // unused: drawn procedurally
		Vector2 Span => new(Projectile.ai[0], Projectile.ai[1]);

		public override void SetDefaults()
		{
			Projectile.width = Projectile.height = 4;
			Projectile.friendly = Projectile.hostile = false;
			Projectile.tileCollide = false; Projectile.timeLeft = 9; Projectile.penetrate = -1;
		}

		public override void AI() => Lighting.AddLight(Projectile.Center + Span / 2, 0.3f, 0.7f, 1.2f);

		public override bool PreDraw(ref Color lightColor)
		{
			var span = Span;
			var a = Projectile.Center;
			var b = a + span;
			var n = new Vector2(-span.Y, span.X).SafeNormalize(Vector2.Zero);
			int segs = Math.Max(3, (int)(span.Length() / 26));
			var pts = new Vector2[segs + 1];
			for (int i = 0; i <= segs; i++)
				pts[i] = Vector2.Lerp(a, b, i / (float)segs) + (i == 0 || i == segs ? Vector2.Zero : n * Main.rand.NextFloat(-16, 16));
			float fade = Projectile.timeLeft / 9f;
			Fx.Additive(true);
			for (int i = 0; i < segs; i++)
			{
				Fx.Line(pts[i], pts[i + 1], 9, new Color(60, 140, 255) * (0.5f * fade));
				Fx.Line(pts[i], pts[i + 1], 3, new Color(220, 245, 255) * fade);
			}
			Fx.Additive(false);
			return false;
		}
	}

	// ------------------------------------------------------------------ Singularity Launcher: black hole

	public class SingularityLauncher : ModItem
	{
		public override string Texture => "FalArsenal/Assets/SingularityLauncher";

		public override void SetDefaults()
		{
			Item.width = 70; Item.height = 34;
			Item.useStyle = ItemUseStyleID.Shoot; Item.useTime = Item.useAnimation = 50; Item.autoReuse = true;
			Item.damage = 34; Item.DamageType = DamageClass.Magic; Item.noMelee = true;
			Item.shoot = ModContent.ProjectileType<SingularityOrb>(); Item.shootSpeed = 11f;
			Item.UseSound = SoundID.Item117; Item.rare = ItemRarityID.Purple;
		}

		public override Vector2? HoldoutOffset() => new Vector2(-10, 0);

		public override void AddRecipes() => CreateRecipe()
			.AddRecipeGroup(RecipeGroupID.IronBar, 8)
			.AddIngredient(ItemID.Lens, 2)
			.AddIngredient(ItemID.FallenStar, 3)
			.AddTile(TileID.Anvils)
			.Register();
	}

	public class SingularityOrb : ModProjectile
	{
		public override string Texture => "FalArsenal/Assets/HomingMissile"; // unused: drawn procedurally
		const int Travel = 36, Hole = 150;

		public override void SetDefaults()
		{
			Projectile.width = Projectile.height = 20;
			Projectile.friendly = false; Projectile.tileCollide = false; Projectile.penetrate = -1;
			Projectile.timeLeft = Travel + Hole;
		}

		float Age => Travel + Hole - Projectile.timeLeft;
		bool Open => Age >= Travel;

		public override void AI()
		{
			var c = Projectile.Center;
			if (!Open)
			{
				Projectile.velocity *= 0.95f;
				Dust.NewDustPerfect(c, DustID.PurpleTorch, Main.rand.NextVector2Circular(1, 1), 0, default, 1.8f).noGravity = true;
				return;
			}
			Projectile.velocity = Vector2.Zero;
			if (Age == Travel) SoundEngine.PlaySound(SoundID.Item122 with { Pitch = -0.5f }, c);
			float grow = Math.Min(1f, (Age - Travel) / 20f);
			foreach (var n in Main.ActiveNPCs)
			{
				if (n.friendly || n.townNPC) continue;
				var d = c - n.Center;
				float dist = d.Length();
				if (dist > 420) continue;
				float pull = n.boss ? 0.04f : 1.1f * (1 - dist / 420) + 0.25f;
				n.velocity = n.velocity * (n.boss ? 1f : 0.9f) + d.SafeNormalize(Vector2.Zero) * pull * 3f;
				if (dist < 110 && (int)Age % 8 == 0 && Projectile.owner == Main.myPlayer)
					n.SimpleStrikeNPC(Projectile.damage / (n.boss ? 2 : 1), Math.Sign(-d.X), false, 0f, DamageClass.Magic);
			}
			// loose loot gets sucked in too
			foreach (var it in Main.ActiveItems)
				if (Vector2.Distance(it.Center, c) < 300) it.velocity += (c - it.Center).SafeNormalize(Vector2.Zero) * 0.6f;
			for (int i = 0; i < 6; i++)
			{
				var r = Main.rand.NextFloat(40, 190) * grow;
				var a = Main.rand.NextFloat(MathHelper.TwoPi);
				var pos = c + a.ToRotationVector2() * r;
				var tangent = (a + MathHelper.PiOver2).ToRotationVector2();
				Dust.NewDustPerfect(pos, i % 2 == 0 ? DustID.PurpleTorch : DustID.Shadowflame, tangent * 5 + (c - pos) * 0.06f, 0, default, 1.7f).noGravity = true;
			}
			Lighting.AddLight(c, 0.6f, 0.2f, 0.9f);
			if (Projectile.timeLeft == 1) Implode(c);
		}

		void Implode(Vector2 c)
		{
			SoundEngine.PlaySound(SoundID.Item14 with { Pitch = -0.4f }, c);
			SoundEngine.PlaySound(SoundID.Item62 with { Pitch = -0.2f }, c);
			Fx.SmallBoom(c, 2.4f);
			for (int i = 0; i < 50; i++)
				Dust.NewDustPerfect(c, DustID.PurpleTorch, Main.rand.NextVector2Circular(12, 12), 0, default, 2.4f).noGravity = true;
			Main.instance.CameraModifiers.Add(new PunchCameraModifier(c, Main.rand.NextVector2Unit(), 8f, 8f, 20, 2000f));
			if (Projectile.owner == Main.myPlayer)
				foreach (var n in Main.ActiveNPCs)
					if (!n.friendly && !n.townNPC && Vector2.Distance(n.Center, c) < 200) n.SimpleStrikeNPC(Projectile.damage * 3, Math.Sign(n.Center.X - c.X), false, 6f, DamageClass.Magic);
		}

		public override bool PreDraw(ref Color lightColor)
		{
			var c = Projectile.Center;
			var disc = Fx.DiscTexture();
			float pulse = 1 + 0.08f * MathF.Sin(Age * 0.4f);
			if (!Open)
			{
				Fx.Additive(true);
				Main.spriteBatch.Draw(disc, c - Main.screenPosition, null, new Color(190, 90, 255) * 0.9f, 0, new Vector2(12), 1.1f * pulse, SpriteEffects.None, 0);
				Fx.Additive(false);
				return false;
			}
			float grow = Math.Min(1f, (Age - Travel) / 20f);
			float shrink = Math.Min(1f, Projectile.timeLeft / 12f);
			float s = grow * shrink;
			Fx.Additive(true);
			Main.spriteBatch.Draw(disc, c - Main.screenPosition, null, new Color(150, 60, 255) * 0.55f, 0, new Vector2(12), 7.5f * s * pulse, SpriteEffects.None, 0);
			Main.spriteBatch.Draw(disc, c - Main.screenPosition, null, new Color(255, 170, 255) * 0.7f, 0, new Vector2(12), 4.6f * s * pulse, SpriteEffects.None, 0);
			Fx.Additive(false);
			Main.spriteBatch.Draw(disc, c - Main.screenPosition, null, Color.Black, 0, new Vector2(12), 3.6f * s, SpriteEffects.None, 0);
			return false;
		}
	}

	// ------------------------------------------------------------------ Orbital Strike: sky beam

	public class OrbitalStrike : ModItem
	{
		public override string Texture => "FalArsenal/Assets/OrbitalStrike";

		public override void SetDefaults()
		{
			Item.width = 24; Item.height = 38;
			Item.useStyle = ItemUseStyleID.HoldUp; Item.useTime = Item.useAnimation = 40;
			Item.damage = 160; Item.DamageType = DamageClass.Magic; Item.noMelee = true;
			Item.UseSound = SoundID.Item113; Item.rare = ItemRarityID.Red;
		}

		public override bool? UseItem(Player player)
		{
			if (player.whoAmI != Main.myPlayer || player.ownedProjectileCounts[ModContent.ProjectileType<OrbitalBeam>()] > 0) return true;
			var target = Fx.Nearest(Main.MouseWorld, 900, n => n.boss) ?? Fx.Nearest(Main.MouseWorld, 900);
			float x = target?.Center.X ?? Main.MouseWorld.X;
			Projectile.NewProjectile(player.GetSource_ItemUse(Item), new Vector2(x, player.Center.Y), Vector2.Zero, ModContent.ProjectileType<OrbitalBeam>(),
				player.GetWeaponDamage(Item), 0, player.whoAmI, target?.whoAmI ?? -1);
			Main.NewText("Orbital strike locked on.", new Color(120, 220, 255));
			return true;
		}

		public override void AddRecipes() => CreateRecipe()
			.AddRecipeGroup(RecipeGroupID.IronBar, 6)
			.AddIngredient(ItemID.Lens)
			.AddIngredient(ItemID.FallenStar, 5)
			.AddTile(TileID.Anvils)
			.Register();
	}

	/// <summary>Lock-on laser, then a sky beam that sweeps onto its target (ai[0], an NPC index or -1)
	/// and holds it, scorching the ground where it first landed.</summary>
	public class OrbitalBeam : ModProjectile
	{
		public override string Texture => "FalArsenal/Assets/HomingMissile"; // unused: drawn procedurally
		const int Lock = 45, Fire = 120, Fade = 20;

		public override void SetDefaults()
		{
			Projectile.width = Projectile.height = 8;
			Projectile.friendly = false; Projectile.tileCollide = false; Projectile.penetrate = -1;
			Projectile.timeLeft = Lock + Fire + Fade;
		}

		int Age => Lock + Fire + Fade - Projectile.timeLeft;
		public bool Firing => Age >= Lock && Age < Lock + Fire;
		float Width => Age < Lock ? 2f : Age < Lock + 10 ? MathHelper.Lerp(8, 110, (Age - Lock) / 10f) : Age < Lock + Fire ? 110 + 10 * MathF.Sin(Age * 0.5f) : 110 * Projectile.timeLeft / (float)Fade;
		float ground0 = -1; // the surface where the beam first landed: it scorches, it doesn't dig forever
		float Ground => ground0 > 0 ? ground0 : Fx.SurfaceTile((int)(Projectile.Center.X / 16)) * 16f;

		public override void AI()
		{
			int id = (int)Projectile.ai[0];
			if (id >= 0 && Main.npc[id].active) // sweep onto the target
				Projectile.position.X += (Main.npc[id].Center.X - Projectile.Center.X) * (Age < Lock ? 0.2f : 0.06f);
			var ground = new Vector2(Projectile.Center.X, Ground);
			if (Age < Lock)
			{
				if (Age % 15 == 0) SoundEngine.PlaySound(SoundID.MenuTick with { Pitch = 0.6f, Volume = 1f });
				return;
			}
			if (Age == Lock)
			{
				ground0 = Fx.SurfaceTile((int)(Projectile.Center.X / 16)) * 16f;
				SoundEngine.PlaySound(SoundID.Zombie104 with { Volume = 1f });
				SoundEngine.PlaySound(SoundID.Item14 with { Pitch = -0.8f });
				Fx.Flash(0.3f);
			}
			if (Age >= Lock + Fire) return;
			float w = Width;
			Main.instance.CameraModifiers.Add(new PunchCameraModifier(ground, Main.rand.NextVector2Unit(), 3.5f, 12f, 4, 3000f, "orbital"));
			for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++)
				Dust.NewDustPerfect(ground + new Vector2(Main.rand.NextFloat(-w / 2, w / 2), -4), i % 3 == 0 ? DustID.Smoke : DustID.Electric,
					new Vector2(Main.rand.NextFloat(-9, 9), -Main.rand.NextFloat(2, 9)), 0, default, 2f).noGravity = true;
			for (int k = 0; k < 8; k++)
				Lighting.AddLight(new Vector2(Projectile.Center.X, ground.Y - k * 120), 0.8f, 1.4f, 2f);
			if (Projectile.owner != Main.myPlayer) return;
			if (Age % 15 == 0) Fx.Blast(ground + new Vector2(0, 16), 2); // scorch a shallow trench
			if (Age % 6 == 0)
			{
				var column = new Rectangle((int)(Projectile.Center.X - w / 2), (int)(Main.screenPosition.Y - 400), (int)w, (int)(ground.Y - Main.screenPosition.Y + 400));
				foreach (var n in Main.ActiveNPCs)
					if (!n.friendly && !n.townNPC && n.Hitbox.Intersects(column)) n.SimpleStrikeNPC(Projectile.damage, 0, Main.rand.NextBool(4), 0f, DamageClass.Magic);
			}
		}

		public override bool PreDraw(ref Color lightColor)
		{
			float x = Projectile.Center.X, top = Main.screenPosition.Y - 200, bottom = Ground;
			var a = new Vector2(x, top); var b = new Vector2(x, bottom);
			Fx.Additive(true);
			if (Age < Lock)
			{
				float blink = (Age / 5) % 2 == 0 ? 1f : 0.4f;
				Fx.Line(a, b, 3, new Color(255, 40, 40) * blink);
				Main.spriteBatch.Draw(Fx.DiscTexture(), b - Main.screenPosition, null, new Color(255, 60, 60) * blink, 0, new Vector2(12), 1.4f, SpriteEffects.None, 0);
			}
			else
			{
				float w = Width;
				Fx.Line(a, b, w * 1.8f, new Color(40, 120, 255) * 0.35f);
				Fx.Line(a, b, w, new Color(120, 220, 255) * 0.75f);
				Fx.Line(a, b, w * 0.45f, Color.White);
				Main.spriteBatch.Draw(Fx.DiscTexture(), b - Main.screenPosition, null, new Color(120, 210, 255) * 0.45f, 0, new Vector2(12), w / 20f, SpriteEffects.None, 0);
			}
			Fx.Additive(false);
			return false;
		}
	}
}
```

```cs
using Terraria.ModLoader;

namespace FalArsenal
{
	/// <summary>
	/// Fal Arsenal: weapons, enemies and a boss that aren't in vanilla Terraria, with sprites generated
	/// with fal (../assets/make_art.sh). tModLoader finds every ModItem / ModNPC / ModProjectile /
	/// ModSystem / ModCommand in the assembly by itself, so this class stays empty.
	///
	///   Weapons.cs        Homing Missile Launcher, Tactical Nuke
	///   EnergyWeapons.cs  Tesla Rifle, Singularity Launcher, Orbital Strike
	///   Mobs.cs           Scrap Drone, Neon Slime, Mech Walker
	///   Boss.cs           Drone Mothership (+ its rockets)
	///   Fx.cs             explosions, nuke crater + mushroom cloud, flash, camera focus
	///   Commands.cs       /arsenal, /mothership
	/// </summary>
	public class FalArsenal : Mod
	{
	}
}
```

`examples/terraria-tmodloader/FalArsenal/FalArsenal.csproj`:

```csproj
<Project Sdk="Microsoft.NET.Sdk">

	<!-- Import tModLoader mod properties. In ModSources/ that is ..\tModLoader.targets, which tModLoader
	     writes (when Develop Mods opens, or on -build) to point at its install. Built from anywhere else:
	       dotnet build -p:TmlInstallDir=<folder with tModLoader.dll and tMLMod.targets>
	     (not "TMLPath": tMLMod.targets already uses tMLPath, and MSBuild property names ignore case).
	     Keep the first line as it is: tModLoader looks for exactly that Import (Project= first), and
	     offers to "upgrade" the csproj without it. -->
	<Import Project="..\tModLoader.targets" Condition="'$(TmlInstallDir)' == ''" />
	<Import Project="$(TmlInstallDir)/tMLMod.targets" Condition="'$(TmlInstallDir)' != ''" />

</Project>
```
